This feature adds one-click export of all TMF documentation for a study. Options are available for the user to determine what should be included in the export.

feature: Remove Need for Power Delete Permission for Deletion with Reason
description: Users with the permission to execute the Delete Document with Reason action no longer need the Power Delete permission to complete the action.

feature: Create Single SEC Quality Issue When Reclassifying & Using Subartifacts
description: This is an exception to the normal SEC rules whereby if subartifacts are being used, a reclassification of the document will inevitably result in the change of the subartifact as well. Likely this will result in the creation of two SEC QIs (depending on the configuration), and this is unnecessary. Only a single QI is needed.
With this feature, Study Training Admins can send updated Training Matrix drafts for review to relevant stakeholders.

feature: Add Curriculum Group to Training Matrix Builder
description: This feature allows a user to add new section(s) to the Training Matrix Builder. These sections result in a separate Curriculum being created to house associated Training Requirements.
With this feature, Training Requirements which are auto-created through the Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection from the same source document will be considered to be equivalent.

Several enhancements are included in this release to better support Study Training: Blocking Matrix updates when its in the process of being published, specialized responsibilities appropriately grouped, added failure logs for Related record jobs, standard field rule inclusion in person integration point, fixed site license count discrepancies.
When you create a new draft of a Study Training Matrix, changes to the draft are highlighted to provide greater visibility to the changes.
This introduces a new lifecycle state on Training Assignment to indicate that the TA is not expected to ever be completed, but it was not assigned by accident, and is not closed.
The management of User Role Setup records and User Role records can now be automated using the Team, Team Assignment, and Team Member objects.
This feature enables commenting to support review and approval of claims in Vault.
Auto-Linking has been extended to include non-steady state Claims that are assigned to the PreLaunch lifecycle state.

feature: Modular Content: Document Info Panel Enhancements
description: Various user experience improvements have been made to the Modular Content section of the Document Info panel to help streamline the review process of a Material document.

Users can now share direct links to Portal and individual Portal Widgets, including static, dynamic, and system-generated tabs. Links always reflect the current contents of the widget and respect Vault security, ensuring only authorized users can access.

feature: Modular Content: User Mentions for Commenting
description: To continue improving the user experience when reviewing content modules as well as having feature parity with Claims Commenting, users will have the ability to tag/mention others when creating comments. Additionally, minor UX enhancements will be included as well.

feature: eCTD: Flexible Brand Ordering in Bulk Generate
description: When generating multiple packages, the product__v values on a material no longer have to be in the same order to be grouped in the same compliance package.

feature: Veeva AI: Quick Check Agent Entry Criteria
description: A new entry criteria option is now available that allows users to prevent the document from moving forward if the Quick Check Agent has not yet been run on the document version. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

Quick Check Agent is now implemented as an AI Agent on the new Veeva AI Platform. As part of this change, the AI Chat Assistant is now part of the Vault Platform AI Chat, as a dedicated PromoMats Assistant agent. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Veeva AI. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Veeva AI: Show Quick Check in the User's Language
description: The Quick Check Agent results now display in the user's language and locale.

feature: Stability Summary Report: Word Formatted Output
description: This feature enables generation of a Stability Study Report in Word or PDF from a Lab Study or Timepoint. The report consolidates results across timepoints, conditions, and orientations, with options to customize content using Vault’s Word Formatted Output capabilities.

In this release, improvements have been made to the experience of using integrated instruments during Test Execution. Users can trigger requests for data from instruments directly from a Result or manage them through a separate integration partner URL.

feature: Design Data Management: Design Data Portability Support Create New Version
description: This feature enhances the Design Data Loader to support automatic up-versioning of design data records.

feature: Design Data Management: Design Data Portability Support Non-Vault Owner
description: Non-Vault Owners can now use Design Data Import/Export.

feature: Design Data Management: Test Definition Builder
description: The process of creating and managing design data records in LIMS has been simplified, making the process faster, visual, and less error-prone. Design data Admins can easily create or update test definitions from a single interface. Design data Admins also get a visual preview of the output, helping catch mistakes early and reducing back-and-forth corrections later.
This feature allows Design Data Admins and reviewers to easily see what changes were made across the history of a Test Definition, expediting the review process.

feature: Design Data Management: Spec Data Builder
description: This feature simplifies the process of creating and managing design data records in LIMS, making the process faster, visual, and less error-prone. Design data Admins can now easily create or update spec data from a single interface.

feature: Design Data Management: Design Data Portability Performance Improvements
description: Performance is improved when importing large amounts of design data records.

Picklist values for the following picklists can be inactivated: Sample Type, LIMS Criteria Indication, Sampling Point, Collection Type, Core ID Population Choices, Notation, LIMS Precision Type, LIMS Criteria Purpose, Rounding Rule, Evaluate Option.

feature: Prevent Duplicate Documents from Being Added to Test Definitions & Test Sets
description: The same document and version combination cannot be added to the same Test Definition and Test Set.

feature: Sibling Check Related Record State Change Entry Action Available in LIMS
description: "Sibling Check Related Record State Change" Entry Action, which allows the action to execute based on Lifecycle State of sibling records, is now available in LIMS Vaults. Previously, this action was only available in a Quality Vault.

feature: Support for Generate Document from Formatted Output Actions in LIMS
description: LIMS now supports configuring the existing QMS action "Generate Document from Formatted Output" as both a User Action and an Entry Action. Both actions can be added in LIMS vaults and execute without issues.

feature: Add Samples to Empty Test Set
description: Samples' Tests can be added to a new Test Set. Previously, to add a Test to a Test Set, users had to begin a test, which created a test set and added the test to Test Set. Now, when an empty test set is created, users can add tests to a test set from the test set.

feature: Test Definition Document Field Can Be Made Inactive
description: The test_execution_document__v field on Test Definition can be made inactive if the field will no longer be used.

feature: Timepoint Zero Use Batch Results: Sort & Filter Sample & Sample Type
description: This feature adds sorting and filtering capability to the Sample and Sample Type columns of the match selection grid in the popup dialog when selecting Batch Release Tests to use for the Stability Study's initial timepoint.

feature: Automatically Set Amount & Amount Unit on Spec Execution Sample Action
description: Amount and Amount Unit values are now automatically set on Spec Execution Sample Action from the related Spec Data Sample Action.

feature: Warn If Spec Data Not Found During Batch Create
description: When a Batch is created, the user is notified that Spec Data cannot be found for the Batch's Material/Country/Organization. The user can choose to proceed or cancel Batch creation.

feature: Block Reopening Tests on Imported Batches Instead of Blocking Reopening Spec Exes
description: This feature relaxes limitation that blocks reopening a Batch Release Spec Ex with results used in a Timepoint Zero Stability Study. Moving forward, the Batch Release Spec Ex test will be blocked from being reopened unless the Timepoint Zero Stability Study's test is reopened first.

feature: Disallow Updating Batch on Spec Execution After Initiation
description: The batch of a Spec Ex can no longer be updated after the Spec Ex has been initiated.

feature: Disallow Updating Material on Batch After Spec Execution Initiation
description: The material of a batch can no longer be updated after at least one of the batch's related Spec Executions has been initiated.

feature: Lab Sample: Select Sample Action Automatically Set
description: When a Sample is manually set as the Selected Sample field on a Spec Execution Sample Action of type Select, the Spec Execution Sample Action field on the Sample will now automatically reference that Spec Execution Sample Action record. This is already done if AutoMatch is Yes. Now, it's also done if AutoMatch is No.

feature: Merge Evaluated Value Cells Across Timepoints
description: If Study, Test Definition, Result Definition, and Criteria Formula all match for a given Condition/Orientation combination, Vault merges the evaluated value cells across each Timepoint in the report.

The following scenarios are prevented when creating an Aliquot Action: The Aliquot Action's Aliquot Sample Definition (target_sample_definition__v) cannot be greater than 0. Select Sample Action that references an Aliquot Action cannot have its Pull Count greater than 1.

feature: Block Users from Updating Object Type of a Runtime Result
description: The Object Type of a Result can no longer be updated.

feature: Test Set: Updated UI for Ordering Samples
description: The drag style is updated for ordering and reordering Samples in a Test Set.

feature: Create Variation Result Action Excludes Certain Result Records
description: The Create Variation Result action now will not show Results with Aggregate Variables or Cross-Test Variables.

feature: Enhanced Validation to Prevent Loops with Calculated Results
description: When a Spec Data is made effective, an additional check is made to ensure that there no loops with calculated results that could prevent a Test from being completed.

feature: Update Expected User Permission for Certain Objects
description: Users are only required to have Read object permission for certain fields in the following Objects: Criteria Evaluation Set, Criteria Evaluation History, Lab Investigation Request, Lab Test. Previously, Edit field permission was required.

feature: Spec Data Object Type Can No Longer Be Changed
description: Once a Spec Data is created in a certain object type, its object type cannot be changed.
For Test Definition Criteria of type Operational Criteria, the data model is updated to only include 'Alert' as a value for Indication.

feature: Auto-Population of Key Fields for All Stability Lab Samples
description: The fields Study, Study Timepoint, Time Stored, and Time Stored Units are now auto-populated for all Stability Lab Samples, including Initial Timepoints, regardless of Quantity Tracking. Previously, these were only set when Quantity Tracking was enabled.

A Scientific Communication Platform app page is now available where users can educate themselves on pharmaceutical product or medical technology characteristics like safety profiles, efficacy, clinical landscape, and more.
Auto-Linking has been extended to include non-steady state Statements that are assigned to the Reviewed lifecycle state type.

Users can now share direct links to Portal and individual Portal Widgets, including static, dynamic, and system-generated tabs. Links always reflect the current contents of the widget and respect Vault security, ensuring only authorized users can access.

feature: Medical Content Taxonomy for Life Sciences
description: This feature adds a standard set of document types and subtypes for Medical Content. The new document types and subtypes are provisioned inactive.
This feature introduces new standard document fields, document field layouts, picklists, and object fields in Medical.

feature: Pull HCO & Contact Info from OpenData
description: The OpenData HCP import process is enhanced to include affiliated HCO details and contact information.
This feature adds an easy way to include files attached to the Case Response object in the response package sent to the HCP.

feature: Send Emails to the Email Found in the Case Response
description: Inquiry response packages are sent to the email address defined in the Case Contact or Response Contact record associated to the Email Response. Either Contact record may have multiple email addresses related to them. This feature allows the user to determine which of those related email addresses the response package should be sent to.

feature: Generate & Attach Case Report to Case Response or Event
description: This feature streamlines the generation and attachment of Case Reports to the Case Response or the Event via a new action, leveraging Word Formatted Output templates.

feature: Only Show Steady State Documents in the Enhanced Fulfillment Document Picker
description: When adding Fulfillment Documents using Enhanced Fulfillment Document Picker, a default filter will apply so that only Steady State documents are shown. Admins in Vaults using the feature may want to remove the steady state constraint from the criteria VQL configured on the Document field of the Fulfillment Document object.
Related record audit exports and Admin audit exports for documents and objects are now asynchronous, and the exports can now run for a longer time.
To reduce unnecessary notifications, Vault will no longer send notifications if records or documents are created or updated using Vault Loader or the API with Migration Mode enabled.

feature: Outbound Email Domain: Delete Root Domain
description: A root domain can be deleted if it is not yet verified or if there are no Outbound Email Domains that use the root domain.

Admins can define alternative labels to be displayed in the Vault UI within a language to support use cases where different groups of users within a given country or region may have different terminology.

feature: Bulk Support for Document Text Export
description: A text parameter has been added to the export documents API. When set to true, .TXT files with the document text will be included in the export for each document. Vault loader extract will also allow extracting the document text.
Vault now includes over 200 additional Locales to assign to users. A user's assigned Locale determines how dates and numbers are viewed in the Vault user interface.

feature: Email Participants Notification Template Set to Every Occurrence
description: The Email Preferences value of the email_participants__v notification template is set to Every Occurrence if it was previously set to Summary.

The truncation warning that appears when a user's search matches the content in over 5,000 documents is now permanently displayed in the search criteria section rather than temporarily displayed as a banner.
When users are using different Vaults in different browser tabs/windows, Vault sessions will remain active in all tabs if the user uses the Vault Selector to change Vaults within a tab/window.
Admins can now directly configure Document Relationship settings in Admin > Configuration > Document Setup > Document Relationships.

feature: Migration Rendition Reuse for Office & PDFA Files
description: When migrating documents using the file staging server, renditions previously rendered in a lower environment are now reused when migrating to other Vaults.

feature: Provide Additional Fields in Field Dependency Grid & Export
description: To make field dependencies more comprehensible, additional fields are now available for field dependencies in Admin > Configuration > Field Dependencies and the field dependencies Excel export file.

feature: Post-Processing Support for PDFs with Security
description: Vault now renders all PDFs that are not protected from viewing, and applies post-processing (such as overlays, signature pages, and OCR) based on the new "Post processing for PDF files with security" Rendition Profile setting. The legacy "Allow viewing and annotation of protected PDF files" setting is deprecated.  For Vaults with the legacy setting enabled in the Default Rendition Profile, we will auto-enable the new "Post processing for PDF files with security setting" on every Rendition Profile in the Vault.

feature: Enable Move on Brought-Forward Auto Links
description: Users can now move brought-forward Approved Links and Auto-Accepted Links.

feature: Show Lifecycle State on Keyword Link Annotations
description: For keyword link annotations, the lifecycle state is now more visible on the annotation card. Previously, the lifecycle state was visible only on hover.
With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.
Asynchronous Workflow Tasks automatically start a Vault Job and wait for its completion before advancing to the next step. Asynchronous Workflow Tasks are configured using the new workflow job step

feature: Action Trigger Operator Menu Displays All Operators
description: The operator menu now displays the full list of all Vault Formula operators by category and sorts the suggested operators at the top of the list.

feature: Multiple User Reference Fields for Workflow Participant Groups
description: Workflow participant groups that use a user reference field to populate the group now support multiple user reference fields.
Action Triggers now support the IsChanged() function to easily evaluate if fields have been modified so that action triggers are more efficient.

feature: ThisRecord Function Supports Setting Reference Field Value in Action Triggers
description: The CreateRecord() and UpdateRecords() actions within Action Triggers allow the use of the ThisRecord() function when setting a reference field value. This update simplifies the process of linking a newly created record or an updated record to the record that triggered the action.

feature: Latest Document Version Links Available in Document Workflow Notification Template Tokens
description: A new notification template token is now available for multi document workflows that will include the link to the latest version of the document to help users receiving notifications navigate directly to the latest document version. The new token is labeled: Workflow Documents for Latest Version and is available for all envelope object based notification templates.
Lifecycle stages that are inactive and do not have any states associated with it are automatically hidden from the stages UI on document and record detail pages

feature: Email Available Task Owners in Automated Participant Groups
description: The Available Task Owners option is now available within the Email Participants action for participant groups that are automatically populated from roles, groups, or user reference fields.
Object formulas can now reference formula fields when configuring formula fields, field default values, and validation rules.

feature: Word Formatted Output: Object & Rowset Limit
description: Word Formatted Output templates now support referencing up to 40 unique object relationships, an increase from the prior limit of 30. Additionally, Word Formatted Outputs now include an overall Rowset() limit of 50. There are no changes to existing limits for Adobe templates.

feature: Label Limit Increases for Attachment & Workflow Timeline Sections
description: Section Help Content and Section Label limits have been increased from 255 to 500 and 40 to 150 characters respectively for Attachment & Workflow Timeline sections.

feature: Word Formatted Output: Field Label Syntax & Additional Tokens
description: Admins can use syntax to print field labels in addition to field values, so that one Word Formatted Output template can be used for different languages. New syntax is also available to display the language and locale of the user.

feature: Detect Duplicate Persons When Editing Records
description: The existing Duplicate Person Detection functionality has been extended to detect duplicates when existing Person records are edited. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Duplicate Person Detection. Other Vaults require configuration.

Rendering rich text editors has been optimized on record detail pages by introducing a lightweight display mode. This mode hides formatting options and displays content only until a user interacts with it. This enhancement will provide noticeable performance gains for Vaults with layouts containing 10 or more rich text fields or sections.
When searching in picklist fields on objects, Vault will now treat searches as "starts with" rather than "contains".

feature: Support for All Application Roles in Tree Security
description: Tree Security now supports the assignment of all application roles (System, Standard, & Custom).

The Process Monitor tab is now available. This tab provides dynamic visual process exploration functionality, and enables users to visualize key performance indicators over time in an intuitive and interactive format, without the need to configure reports and dashboards.
Users can now drill down on a data group in a dashboard chart to filter the report to display only the relevant data.
Reports now support additional relative date filters, such as Previous Week, Current Week, Next Week, Today, Tomorrow, Yesterday, and "is in the last full" (days, weeks, months, years).

feature: Enhanced Merge Cells in Multi-Pass Reports
description: A new option is available to merge cells in multi-pass reports only when the primary object is merged in the report. Merged cells are also now included in flash report emails, PDF exports, and formatted Excel exports.

feature: Support Created By & Last Modified By Fields in Report Formula Fields
description: Users can now add the Created By and Last Modified By fields in report formula fields.
Descriptions and Footers can now be defined on dashboard charts.
Standard matrix reports now support the use of formula fields and adding additional columns to display to users when drilling into data.

feature: Support Ladder Multi-Pass Reports in Dashboards
description: Ladder Multi-Pass reports are now available in dashboards.

feature: Search Filters on Non-Primary Objects in Reports
description: Users can now add Search operators to filters for rich text and long text fields on non-primary objects in reports.

feature: Report Export Limit Increase for Excel
description: Reports exported to Excel can now contain a maximum of 250,000 rows, increased from 100,000 rows.

Admins can now set the Session Duration per Security Policy. The value is defaulted to the domain-level value, but Admins can now set an override at the Security Policy level. The Session Duration set at the Security Policy level is enforced for all Vaults in a user's domain. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

Admins with appropriate permissions are now able to log in as an end-user with a more streamlined Log In As option, leveraging the existing Delegate Access functionality. *This feature is Auto-on for standard Vault Owners and System Administrators in Vaults configured for Delegate Access. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Privilege Escalation for Security Policy Conversions
description: Vault will now prevent Admins from using the Convert Security Policy action on Users who have more permissions than the Admin initiating the update. In these cases, the Convert Security Policy option will not display in the Actions menu.

feature: Login Audit History: My Vaults Page
description: For domains that have the My Vaults page enabled, a new login event type is now available when landing on the My Vault page. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.
Admins will now be able to leverage a new standard User Layout that takes advantage of Pages and Layout Rules to better organize the layout.

feature: Delegate Access: Vault Owner Group Restriction
description: Admins can now use the "Delegate access allowed only among group members" option on the standard Vault Owners group.
The available limit of User Roles for a single user is increased from 15 to 50.
Site Connect users can see a list of their Studies on the VeevaID website.
VeevaID users will now be prompted for Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) when logging in from a new country for the first time, or when logging in from two different countries within 4 hours.

feature: Customizable Timeout Period for SDK Jobs
description: Admins can now specify a timeout duration for custom SDK jobs.

feature: Bulk-Cancel Jobs in Queued or Queueing State
description: Admins can now cancel in bulk certain jobs in the Queued or Queueing states.

feature: Scheduled Data Exports: Entity Modification Limits
description: When modifying Scheduled Data Export configurations, the system enforces a strict limit of 30 entities. Modifying the scheduled run time and requesting a full export are allowed as long as the entities are not modified or within limit.

feature: Retaining Sandbox Snapshots Enabled By Default
description: This feature, which allows Vault to provide an option to change the source of a Snapshot when deleting a Sandbox, is now enabled for all Vaults.

feature: Vault Loader Support for Changing Object Type
description: Vault Loader now supports changing Object Types assigned to object records.
Users can make decisions and close Disposition Items on the Batch Disposition Execution Page.
Batch Release now checks the Genealogy against the bill of materials (BoM) to ensure they match.
Admins can configure the Disposition and Check Due Date to use either a Date or Date/Time field.

feature: Genealogy Check Using Bill of Materials
description: Batch Release now creates and uses Bill of Material (BoM) to evaluate quality events related to Materials.
A quick filter button has been added for users to view their open checks.
This feature expands the reassign external collaborator feature to include reassigning checklists associated to an external collaborator record.
External collaboration is expanded for Organization and Qualification objects.

feature: Action Path Enhancements: Improved Flexibility & UI
description: Multiple enhancements have been made across Admin configuration, runtime behavior, and end user experience to provide more flexibility when leveraging action paths.
Supplier Risk Assessment is a structured process used to identify, analyze, and mitigate potential risks associated with engaging or continuing to use a supplier.

feature: Field Corrective Action: Ingest Reply from External Persons
description: This feature allows the recipient of the External Notification to Reply back to the email and Vault automatically attaches the reply to the corresponding Product Action record.

feature: Record Check & Suggestions: New Configuration Options
description: Recurrence Checks, Duplicate Checks, and Quality Event Suggestions now have additional configuration settings. These new settings offer greater control over how record checks and suggestions are displayed and executed by providing the option to hide similarity scores and exclude alphanumeric values from matching terms.

feature: Enable Auditing for Standard Legacy Migration Objects
description: This feature allows Admins to turn on Auditing for the following standard objects: Legacy System, Legacy Process Record, Legacy Process Artifact, Related Legacy Process Record

feature: Reason for Change: Support for Inline Edits
description: Reason for Change is now supported when governed fields are updated in a list of records. This feature is automatically enabled in Vaults where the Reason for Change feature is already configured. If a Vault does not have any active Reason for Change configurations, this feature does not have any impact.

This feature enables users to send notifications to users working on inspection requests directly through the Audit Room functionality. Leveraging preconfigured notification templates, users can ensure timely and consistent communication, improving coordination and response times during inspections.

feature: Record Check & Suggestions: User Interface Enhancements
description: The Record Check dialog now features enhanced clarity for viewing the record check definition. For Vaults allowing override of Suggested Terms, the user interface for Record Checks and Suggestions is improved, enabling users to specify terms to be ignored.
Hovercards are added to Quality Team members' names displaying related user information.

feature: Quality Record Checks with Non-Editable Prompts: Display Exact Match Field Values
description: If Quality Record Check's editable prompts on exact match fields is not enabled, Vault displays read-only exact match field values in the Run Record Check dialog. The values are derived from the record the action is being run on and are limited to Object, Boolean, and Picklist types.
This feature will allow Vault to send a notification to multiple users as a group.

feature: Action Path Enhancements: Only Complete In Progress Action Steps
description: This feature ensures Action Steps are not prematurely completed when the last Change Action is cancelled or deleted by requiring an Action Step to be in the In Progress status to complete it.

feature: Record Suggestion: New Record Suggestion Icon
description: The existing sparkle icon used for the Record Suggestion feature now leverages the lightbulb icon. The lightbulb icon is now displayed instead of the sparkle icon when executing the action and on record layouts.

feature: Action Paths: Add Action Path Validation
description: In Vaults that leverage Action Paths for Change Controls, the Add Action Path action will now validate that the Change Control is not already associated to an existing action path. This can occur if multiple Add Action Paths are configured when creating a record or when a Change Control that is already associated to an Action Path is copied to create a new one. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Action Paths. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Streamlined Controlled Copy Reconciliation with Barcodes or QR Codes
description: This feature allows users to reconcile printed controlled copies in a streamlined manner using barcodes and QR codes that may be placed on the controlled copy overlay. The printed controlled copies can then be scanned using a scanner on the new Controlled Copies for Reconciliation page where a bulk reconciliation workflow may be initiated.

feature: Ability to Disable the Relationships Panel
description: The Relationships panel can be disabled via a new application setting.
External Collaborators collaborating on a Document Review or Document Approval task via the External Collaboration for Documents feature are granted the permission to download the document.

feature: Automated Inactivation of Document Change Request & Periodic Review Records
description: Two new entry actions automatically inactivate associated Document Change Request or Periodic Review records when the target document reaches the lifecycle state where the respective entry action has been configured.
The feature allows document control users to filter the data in each section of the Document Control Homepage.
This feature includes several minor Process Navigator enhancements that do not require any additional configuration.

feature: Dynamic Association of Process Navigator Documents Enhancement
description: Process Owners can download a CSV file of the dynamically-matched documents when previewing Document Association Criteria.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel: Document Change Request Section Enhancement
description: The Description of the Document Change Request record is added to the hovercard that displays upon hover of the Document Change Request record in the Quality Relationships Panel.

feature: Station Manager: Tabbed View of Documents
description: This feature allows Station Manager operators to open up to 10 documents in a tabbed view to quickly and easily access multiple documents on the manufacturing floor.

feature: Operating System Information Tracking in Station Device Records
description: The Station Device record now stores the Operating System and Operating System version of the device running the Station Manager iOS or Android app.

feature: Display Latest Steady State Documents on Learner Task Page
description: We are enhancing the Learner Task Page to display information about the training content set associated with a completed Training Assignment and when clicking on a Training Assignment to always display the in use training content set.
Users can export in CSV format from Training Homepages: Learner Homepage, My Team Page.
The My Learning Tab now lets Vault show up to 10 plain text messages. Admins can choose who sees them by setting conditions based on a user's learner roles or other personal data.
This feature includes a grouping of small enhancements to accessibility (color contrast), Instructor-Led Training, Curriculum Outcomes permissions, Substitute Rules, and minor security updates.

feature: Self Enrollment & Direct Assignment: No Due Date Option
description: This feature allows a Training Admin to configure special due date options for Trainings assigned via Direct Assignment or as Self-Enrollment.
Existing Training Requirement Impact Assessment (TRIA) records with a blank Execution Date will be updated to include the date of when the TRIA workflow for that record was last completed.
Currently, both certificates and user credentials are required to process Acknowledgements from the FDA. With this feature, customers can choose to only authenticate using certificates.
This feature adds a new field on Adverse Event Report object.

feature: VPS: Adverse Event Report Due Date Calculation Improvements
description: This feature enhances the due date calculation for Adverse Event Reports when new information is received on the complaint.
This feature updates the truncation rules for PMDA.

feature: VPS: Adverse Event Report PDF Text Wrapping
description: This feature optimizes text wrapping to best use the available space in the PDF.
Users can submit requests for changes to the Training Matrix that can be implemented automatically at a specific time, eliminating the need for Training Admins to manually create records.

This feature lets authors replace lengthy instructions with a clear visual reference directly in the test, improving clarity, consistency, and reducing errors. Executors get immediate access to critical information. The feature is enabled through configuration.

The user experience has been simplified so that Entity Version is no longer required for all queries and capabilities in Validation Management by discipline. This ability is provided through new layout controls for the Entity, which allow for the management of Requirements (app section) and entity version fields (app control).

feature: In-Scope Requirements & Specifications for Validation Activity
description: This feature lets users define in-scope requirements for a validation activity. RTMs are now auto-updated with correct activity values, and the Challenge Status filter in the Burndown panel is relabeled to “Never Challenged in Entity Version.” The feature is Auto-on but requires configuration to fully use it.

This feature adds improvements to the existing Requirement Entity Version section to rename the Add/Remove actions to Link/Unlink Requirements and provide clearer error messages when Atomic Security configurations block the creation of Requirements or the creation or removal of Requirement Entity Version records.
The new template requirement logic that was refactored in 25R1 is now enforced on all Vaults.

The system now supports publishing and validating Tunisia eCTD Submissions based on Tunisia specification version 1.1 (DTD v1.1). validation performed against version 1.0 of the Validation Criteria version 1.1.
The system now supports validating Japan eCTD 4.0 Submissions based on PMDA Validation Criteria v1.6.0.
The system now supports publishing and validating Bosnia eCTD Submissions based on Bosnia's specification version 1.0 and DTD version 3.1
The system now supports validating EU eCTD Submission based on version 3.1 DTD, specification version 3.1.1 and validation version 8.2.

feature: Auto-Return Bookmarks for Table of Contents
description: When the Publishing Element is set to create return bookmarks, all published documents, published as Viewable Rendition, will automatically get a bookmark that takes you back to the Table of Contents.

feature: Exclude Non-PDF Documents from Link Evaluator
description: Non-PDF Documents will no longer display in Link Evaluator. Previously non-PDF documents would appear with inaccurate link information and no actions could be taken on them.

feature: Add Bookmark Level Column to Edit Table of Contents Page
description: A new column Bookmark Level is added to the Edit Table of Contents page that can be referenced when using the Include Bookmarks to Defined Level action to specify which level of bookmarks should be displayed in a system generated table of contents.

feature: Support Accurate Table of Contents Linking for Multiple CPI Matches
description: The Table of Contents now creates unique links for each instance of a document, even when the same document is matched to multiple items CPIs with unique POLs.
General fixes to improved validation have been made across the following regions and rules: EU v8.1 and v8.2 - Rule 11BP2.

feature: Bring Forward Annotations for Keyword Links
description: For keyword links users can now move brought-forward Approved Links and Auto-Accepted Links. Lifecycle State will appear on keyword link annotations

feature: XML Operation Field Respects Default Value for eCTD 4.0 & EAEU Content Plan
description: To align with behavior of CTD Content Plan Template creation the XML Operation field will default to empty if there is no default configured for the XML Operation field.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
description: This feature introduces new objects and fields, including a new Health Authority Response object, to better support tracking of responses to health authority questions. A new Initiate Response user action and guided flow allows users to initiate the response document and other response activities more efficiently.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
description: Prediction metrics will be updated daily and cycled with each release rather than only monthly updates.

feature: Restrict Tokens for Use in Standard Notification Templates
description: Some notification template tokens have been available for use in notification templates where they have not been supported for resolution. This feature restricts the tokens such that they are only available for use in notification templates where they are supported for resolution.
System-managed fields that drive the submission structure and display elements in Submissions Archive Viewer on the Submission Metadata object are made read-only. Custom fields remain editable.

feature: Export API: Support for Published Submissions
description: Submissions Archive Export API is extended to support the export of published-in-Vault submissions via the Vault API.

To streamline eCTD 4.0 viewing in Submissions Archive Viewer, Health Authority eCTD Keywords will now appear only on document rows, not sections. This provides essential context at the document level without adding redundant information.

feature: Viewing Sender Defined eCTD 4.0 Keywords on Published Submissions
description: For eCTD 4.0 submissions, the Code System OID for sender-defined keywords on the first submission is blank until the 'Health Authority Received' state. The OID appears on all subsequent submissions and for all Health Authority keywords.
When an Event’s scope changes, users can review and update existing local regulatory information, such as Submissions.
Vault groups similar Change Items together based on Product Family, making it easier for users to find, assess, and disposition the changes included in an Event.
This feature adds the ability to generate container packages submissions for container package update submissions to EUDAMED.

feature: EUDAMED Acceptance: Data Updates to Support Compliance
description: Health Authority submission acceptance triggers updates for Registered Device Identifier relationships, which will support additional business rule validation for Market Information and Container Package submissions.
This feature includes enhancements to the impact assessment process: impact assessment and activity creation for a specific set of countries; optional prompts in impact assessment reports.

feature: EUDAMED Market Information Machine-to-Machine & Viewer Support
description: Users can generate, review, and send Market Information submissions for registered devices directly from Vault to EUDAMED using a machine-to-machine (M2M) connection.

feature: EUDAMED Container Packages Machine-to-Machine & Viewer Support
description: Users can generate, review, and send device container package submissions for registered devices directly from Vault to EUDAMED using a machine-to-machine (M2M) connection.

feature: Update to Defaulting Local Differences Logic
description: The defaulting logic introduced in 25R2 to default attributes based on local differences has been updated. The defaulting process now executes before validation matching, instead of after, to correctly match on defaulted attributes. Validation and splitting records based on different combinations of ingredient details have also been updated.

feature: Create GCP from Active Dossier: Baseline from Application Support
description: A new action is introduced to Create Global Content Plans with an option to match current documents from a reference Application, tracked in Active Dossier, as a baseline for the next change event.

feature: Vault Loader, VPK & Bulk Updates for Activity & Content Plan Item Deletion
description: As a prerequisite to delete Activity or Content Plan Item records using Vault Loader, Bulk Action, or VPK, users must first confirm that the Document Set field is blank on all records.

feature: RIM Notification Templates: Email Preference Updates
description: In this release, the Email Preference is updated to Every Occurrence for specific Notification Templates in Submissions Archive and Registrations. This ensures pertinent information is delivered via Vault Notification Emails, instead of in the Vault Summary Email Preference format.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Extract Proposed Active Dossier Relationships for Registrations & Product Information Tracking
description: A new bulk action can be executed on applications to extract the inferred Active Dossier Item Detail relationship records of existing Active Dossier records for four new relationship objects: ADID Registration, ADID Product Variant, ADID Manufacturer, and ADID Inactive Ingredient.

Users can now create Event-specific Document Set records manually or from templates. Users can track definition, owner, and status, with the option to configure workflows for collaboration. In the Content Plan Viewer, users can reference Document Set information using hovercards, assign Document Sets to Content Plan Items using bulk edit actions, and apply the View by Document Set filter to prepare for dispatch.

feature: Content Plan Viewer: Header Styling Update
description: The CP Viewer header row now has a new gray background and a drop-down to apply the special "View by Activity" filter for GCPs. When used, special filters such as "View by Activity" and "View as Root" have updated styling in the list of applied filters.

feature: Content Plan Viewer: View by Activity Filter for GCP
description: The CP Viewer header has a new drop-down to apply the special "View by Activity" filter for GCPs. When used, special filters such as "View by Activity" and "View as Root" have updated styling in the list of applied filters.

feature: Trigger to Prevent Reparenting Sections Across GCPs
description: GCP sections can no longer be re-parented from one GCP into a different GCP. Note that other reparenting scenarios are still allowed. GCP sections can still be dragged and dropped from one hierarchy into another, with existing limitations (lack of support for Event relationships) and new limitations (lack of support for Document Sets).

feature: Submissions Archive Harmonization for eCTD 4.0 Keywords
description: To ensure an accurate Submissions Archive view, the Harmonization job now supports Sender-Defined Keywords in non-sequential ICH eCTD 4.0 imports. Additionally, Vault now notifies users of unrecognized Sender Keyword Codes from missing submissions to aid troubleshooting.

feature: eCTD 4.0 Viewing: Document Reuse & Document Title Display
description: Submissions Archive Viewer display handles intra-application Document Title Updates for eCTD 4.0 Document Re-use.
Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting for Tunisia (TN) eCTD v1.1 based on the ICH eCTD v3.2 standard.

feature: Bosnia and Herzegovina eCTD 3.2 Archive & Viewing (BA v3.1)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting for Bosnia and Herzegovina (BA) eCTD v1.1 based on the ICH eCTD v3.2 standard.

feature: Hide Cumulative View for Japan eCTD 3.2 Submissions
description: Submissions Archive Viewer does not support the Cumulative View user action due to the cumulative XML structure of JP XSD 1.0. The Cumulative View action is hidden from the Actions menu on sections in the Name column.

feature: eCTD Metadata Updates: Document Reuse Optimization
description: For eCTD 4.0 submissions, where documents are reused across multiple applications, document title updates are displayed in Viewer and exported via the eCTD Metadata Updates feature.

feature: Import Notification for Missing Primary Filename
description: Submissions Archive now provides a Warning message when an imported dossier contains one or more files that lack a primary filename (such as .docx). Vault uses the file's extension as the Document Name for the Submissions Archive Document during import, and the 'Import complete with warnings' notification lists each Document Name for user review.

feature: File Name Update for Import Results Attachment
description: In this release, the Submissions Archive Import Results CSV file name is updated to append a system-generated unique identifier at the end of the file name. This update only affects the file name of the Import Results CSV, not the structure or content of the file.

feature: Active Dossier Viewer: Filter by Section
description: A new global filter called Section is available in the Active Dossier viewer and allows users to filter the Active Dossier by sections in the Active Dossier Template.

feature: Active Dossier Support for Clinical Study, Nonclinical Study & Indication
description: This feature adds support for tracking documents associated with a Clinical Study, Indication, and Nonclinical Study in Active Dossier. New Active Dossier Templates & RIM Reference Models are provisioned for tracking CTD modules 4 & 5. Special logic is introduced for tracking published RLCP documents and their source documents.

The Active Dossier Country hovercard is updated to display dates and comments. The Registrations and additional Product information hovercards are also updated to reduce noise by removing the column filters and search bar, with an added pop-out icon to allow further search and filter on the related records.

feature: Tag Only Clinical Trial Study Cases as SUSAR
description: Admins can now configure their Vault to tag Case Assessments as SUSAR only when they are associated with a clinical trial study.

feature: Convert FDA VAERS E2B(R3) Validations to Vault Expressions
description: This feature transitions Veeva Safety from JSON-based Case Data Validations to Vault Expression Validations and updates some FDA VAERS E2B(R3) validations.

feature: FDA eMDR Generation & Manufacturing Report Number Automation
description: This feature introduces the generation of FDA eMDR XML files and adds fields and objects for tracking and exporting manufacturing sites and manufacturing report numbers to the FDA eMDR XML and the August 2024 version of the FDA MedWatch 3500A form.
Veeva Safety now supports the use of Unknown Formulation Products during adverse event intake and processing.

feature: Blinded Cases Rule Evaluation for Agencies
description: The Safety Reporting Rule Engine now supports determining agency reportability for blinded clinical trial Cases.

feature: Patient Content Protection: Mask PII (EU Guidance)
description: This feature introduces a Patient Content Protection parameter to meet requirements for EU GVP Module VI Addendum.

feature: Process Completion Date Population for Inactive Cases
description: When a Case moves into the Inactive lifecycle state, Vault now populates the Process Completion Date with the current date and time.
This feature adds the Combination Product Type field to the Product object, which identifies when Combination Products include drugs, devices, or both.
With this release, Veeva Safety can always exclude concomitant drug role products from auto-coding against the Company Product library.

feature: Manage Blind Protection for Case Narratives
description: Admins can now use the Turn off Blind Protection on Narrative setting without first having to enable the Enable Isolation of Blinded Product Information setting.

feature: Inbox Item to Case Compare Page: Option to Ignore All from Specific Origins
description: Admins can now define sender origins that can include a selectable Ignore All option on the Inbox Item to Case Compare page.

feature: Extend Upgrade to Latest Action to Update MedDRA SMQs
description: The Upgrade to Latest action now loads the latest version of Standard MedDRA Queries (SMQs) into a Vault, in addition to upgrading the MedDRA terms.

feature: Auto-Update Related Case Identifiers in Case Relationships
description: Vault can now update Related Case Identifiers following edits to Case Relationship records.

feature: Multi-Case CSV Data Import: Low-Touch Automation Efficiency
description: This features introduces support for more objects, fields, and limits across both tabular data imports and the JSON API.

This feature updates Rules Based Narrative generation with support for the list and LIST operators for any Case child object, provides standard Narrative Outlines, and adds Narrative Text to Case Follow-up Statements following bulk unblind follow-up creation.

feature: Korea Drug Browser Support for Case Drug History
description: This feature introduces Korean Drug Coding on Case Drug History for domestic Cases and foreign Localized Cases reportable to Korea.

Admins can now enable Sender-Based Inbound Validation for inbound sources that also use Automated Case Promotion or Local Intake Auto-Translation for E2B transmissions received via the AS2 Gateway or Vault API.

feature: Allow Case Data Expressions to Reference Inbound Transmissions
description: This feature extends the Case Data - Expression parameter to allow references to Inbound Transmissions for Safety Reporting Rules and Validation Criteria.

feature: Imported Follow Up Information Cases for Migration
description: This feature adds the Imported Follow Up Information object type to the Case object.

feature: Enablement Update: Convert EMA E2B(R3) Validations to Vault Expressions
description: With this release, the Convert EMA E2B(R3) Validations to Vault Expressions feature is Auto-on. This feature was originally introduced in 25R2 with Support-enablement.
This feature provisions the Alias Type picklist on the Product Alias object.

With this release, Vault no longer creates a corresponding Gateway Profile following creation of an AS2 Gateway-type Transmission Profile, and enables creating an unlimited number of Transmission Profiles for use with AS2 Connections.
This feature adds the Gestation Age at Outcome control field to the Case object.
Veeva Safety now supports encoding transmission files using Base64 for ICSR Transmissions sent by AS2 Gateway.

feature: Windows-style Line Endings for Transmission Files
description: Veeva Safety now supports Windows-style line endings in transmission files.
This feature introduces the generation of the CIOMS I (Chinese) form.
This feature introduces Dechallenge calculations on Case Assessments based on the Action Taken on Case Products and the Outcome on Case Adverse Events.
This feature updates the EU MIR PDF form to version 7.3.1 and enables exporting this report in PDF and XML format.

feature: NMPA E2B(R3): Data Model, Mapping, Validation, & Syncing Updates
description: This feature updates the data model, mapping, validation, and syncing of the NMPA E2B(R3) file.

feature: Inbox Item to Case Compare Page: Improved Matching & Highlights
description: This feature updates the matching logic on the Inbox Item to Case Compare page and adds visual indicators on Case records that could be potential matches to new incoming records.
With this release, Vault tags Cases as SUSAR only when the Report Type is Study.

feature: PMDA: Clear Case Product Registrations for Inactive Products
description: When processing PMDA-reportable Cases, the Retrieve Reportable Case Product Registrations action on Localized Cases now clears out non-reportable Case Product Registrations when the related Products have been inactivated or deprecated.
This feature adds the Transmission Sent Date and Transmission Completed Date fields to the Transmission object.

feature: Document Intake Highlighter: Display Annotations in View Mode
description: The Document Intake Highlighter panel now shows highlighted terms in View mode.

feature: Auto-Code CAS Numbers for Case External Products
description: Following Vault-creation of External Case Product Substance records, Vault now automatically codes Chemical Abstracts Services (CAS) Numbers associated with substances.

feature: Validation Criteria: Added First and Last Admin Date Validations
description: This feature introduces ICH validation criteria for G.k.4.r.4 and G.k.4.r.5 to check that the First Admin Date is not earlier than the Last Admin Date.

feature: Validation Criteria: Add Reason Omitted Requirements for FDA.D.11 & FDA.D.12
description: This feature updates the FDA.D.11-RO validation criteria to require Race (Reason Omitted) if Race is blank and the FDA.D.12-RO validation criteria to require Patient Ethnicity (Reason Omitted) if Patient Ethnicity is blank.

feature: FDA MedWatch 3500A (August 2024 Version): Compounded Product Update
description: This feature adds support for the G.4 Compounded Product field on the FDA MedWatch 3500A (August 2024 version) form.

When generating MFDS E2B(R3) files for domestic Cases that are not associated with a study, if the Localized Case Assessment Result does not contain a Localized Assessment Result, Vault now exports a value based on the Assessment Result on the Case Assessment Result to the G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1 WHO-UMC Result of Assessment data element.

feature: Non-Current Tag for Japanese MedDRA Coding
description: When coding non-current Japanese MedDRA terms, Veeva Safety now displays a NON-CURRENT tag, along with displaying the coded Japanese term as “-”.
This feature updates the FDA E2B(R3) validation criteria for FDA.D.9.1 to include the following nullFlavors: MSK, ASKU, and NASK.

feature: Validation Criteria: Exclude Treatment Drug Role from FDA.G.K.1-2,3,4
description: This feature updates the following FDA E2B(R3) validation criteria to exclude Treatment Drug Role: FDA.G.K.1-2, FDA.G.K.1-3, and FDA.G.K.1-4.

feature: Validation Criteria: Updated Marketing Definitions for FDA E2B(R3) Validations
description: This feature updates the marketing definitions for FDA E2B(R3) validations and performs the evaluation of the following validation criteria at the Submission level only: FDA.C.5.4-1, FDA.D.9.1, FDA.G.K.1-1, FDA.G.k.12.r.3.r, and FDA.G.K.9.i.2.r.3-1.

feature: Validation Criteria: MFDS.G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1-1,2 Check Global Case Data
description: This feature updates the MFDS validation criteria for WHO-UMC (MFDS.G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1-1 and MFDS.G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1-2) to evaluate global Case data, in addition to Localized Case data.

feature: Validation Criteria: Update ICH G.k.2.2 and H.1 for NMPA Submissions
description: This feature updates NMPA E2B(R3) Submission validation to not evaluate the ICH.G.k.2.2 and ICH.H.1 validation criteria if there are no Localized Cases for the NMPA.

feature: Enhanced Product Browser for Studies with Unspecified Products
description: In Vaults with Faster Case Product Selection enabled, the Product Browser now displays for imported Inbox Items that have a Study with Unspecified Products.

With this release, for AS2 Gateway ACKs/MDNs sent using UTF-16, Vault now creates the MDN and ACK Transmission Message by populating the content of the XML file in the Body of the Transmission Message.

feature: Enhanced Potential Matches Page for Duplicate Detection
description: This feature introduces a new Potential Matches page with user interface, category match, and comparison table improvements. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for the Duplicate Search Potential Matches Page. Other Vaults require configuration.

Veeva Safety now codes Korea Ministry of Food and Drug Services (MFDS) Substance IDs and Substance Names on External Localized Case Product Substance records for domestic Cases and foreign Localized Cases reportable to Korea.

feature: PMDA: Clear Non-Reportable Case Product Registrations
description: With this release, when processing PMDA-reportable Cases, the Retrieve Reportable Case Product Registrations action on Localized Cases now removes non-reportable Case Product Registrations if no PMDA-reportable registration exists for the Product.

feature: PMDA Medical Device and Regenerative Medicine Reporting: Data Model
description: This feature provisions the data model to support future PMDA reporting functionality.
This feature supports running Signal Calculations using standard and custom MedDRA queries.

With this feature, Veeva Signal provides an option to determine Listedness based on Company Core Datasheets (CCDS) from all Products within a Product Family, instead of looking at the Case Assessment field Listedness from Core Datasheets.

feature: Calculations and Statistical Data Creation for FAERS
description: This feature enables running calculations on quarterly FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) adverse event reports.
This feature provisions fields and picklists on the Statistical Data object to support future subgrouping functionality.

feature: Successful Record Creation During Scheduled Calculations
description: During scheduled Signal Calculation runs, if some parts of the data creation fail, Vault now retains successfully created records. By default, this feature is Visible to All Users who have View permissions for the System Processing lifecycle state.

feature: Supplemental Reports for Workbench PADER Aggregate
description: This feature supports the creation of supplemental Workbench PADER aggregate reports.
The SQL editor on Safety views now displays SQL error messages and includes a downloadable log file for errors when users run Reports or Dashboards.

feature: Clearer Error Handling for Workbench View Configuration Errors
description: In this release, Safety Workbench improves error handling when Admins configure Workbench Views.

feature: Dynamic Views for Ad-Hoc Report Customization
description: This feature allows Admins to configure Dynamic Views, expanding the list of commonly used Safety fields for ad-hoc reporting.
This feature introduces syntax highlighting, line numbers, and keyboard shortcuts to the SQL Editor section on Safety views.

feature: Cancel a Running Workbench Report or Dashboard
description: With this feature, users can cancel running Workbench Reports, and Vault automatically cancels Dashboard executions if a user applies new filters or leaves the page.

feature: Workbench DSUR & PBRER Case Completed Filter
description: This feature includes the option to include or exclude open Cases when running Workbench DSUR and PBRER aggregate reports.

feature: Navigate to a Safety Object from Workbench
description: With this feature, Workbench Dashboards and Workbench Report Excel outputs include links to Safety object records.

feature: Export a Workbench Dashboard Component as CSV
description: Users can now export data directly from a Workbench Dashboard Component to a CSV file.

feature: Filter a Workbench Report Using Starts With and Contains Operators
description: Users can now filter reports using the "starts with" and "contains" operators for text fields.

feature: Filter a Workbench Report by Signal Case Series
description: This feature allows users to constrain Workbench Report results to only the Cases within a Signal Case Series.

feature: Generate Reports from Workbench Dashboard Components
description: Users can now create a new Workbench Report, which will run automatically, directly from a Workbench Dashboard Component.
This feature adds paging, sorting, and record counts to Workbench Dashboards.
This feature updates the Scheduler functionality in SafetyDocs and Workbench, including enabling scheduling monthly activities on a specific day of the week or the last day of the month.

feature: Simplified Deletion for Case Products & Adverse Events
description: Following Case Product and Case Adverse Event deletion, Veeva Safety now cascades the deletion to and clear references in related records.

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
description: Updated standard layouts and added new standard fields across Safety applications. Standard layouts have been inactivated (for reference only).

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
description: With this release, Veeva Safety introduces a standard Safety Coding tab collection that includes Dictionaries, Studies, Products, MedDRA, and Watchlists menus.

feature: Product Family Support for PV Agreements
description: This feature supports classifying Pharmacovigilance Agreements (PVAs) by Product Family.
This feature enables Admins to configure Pharmacovigilance Agreement (PVA) templates with clauses and subclauses and generate draft documents from PVA Outlines.
This feature supports the creation of two types of Core Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and introduces a picklist field for labeling Core RMPs as Company Core RMPs or EU RMPs.
This feature supports creating PVA Multi-Agreement Activity records that span multiple Pharmacovigilance Agreements (PVAs).

feature: Clearer Error Handling When Generating PSMF PDFs
description: Veeva SafetyDocs now alerts users if they attempt to generate a PSMF PDF file from a PSMF Binder that contains placeholder generated documents with missing required fields.

feature: Convert HTML Markup in Literature Abstracts
description: This feature converts HTML markup in the Abstract field of Literature Articles imported from external databases to formatted text.
This feature supports link annotations between documents in a PSMF binder and maintains links when generating PSMF PDFs.

feature: Risk Measure Support for EMA GVP Module XVI Revision 3
description: SafetyDocs now aligns with EMA's updated guidance on categorizing and subcategorizing additional risk minimization measures (aRMMs).

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: CTMS Managed Protocol Deviations
description: With this feature, the Clinical Operations-EDC Connection limits the updates to CTMS managed Protocol Deviation to avoid data in CTMS being overwritten by updates in EDC.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Prevent EDC Study Name Duplicates
description: With this feature, the connection will not update the study label in EDC if the study name is already used by an existing EDC study or study instance. This feature maps to the "Clinical Operations - EDC Connection: Enforcing Unique Study Names" (25R3-074001) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: New Integration Field Rule
description: This feature adds a field rule to the Study Design Type field on the Study object in Clinical Operations Vaults.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Linking Parent & Child Case Information
description: On promotion of Inbox Items generated from EDC Casebooks for child subject SAEs, Vault now creates and updates the applicable Pregnancy, Child Information, and Parent Information types of Cases for processing in Safety. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: Linking Parent/Child Subject Information & Relevant Cases" (25R3-071009) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Improvements for Mapping, Merging & Error Handling
description: This feature introduces error handling and mapping enhancements to the Safety-EDC Connection.

feature: Clinical Operations-eCOA Connection: End of Study Media
description: This feature enables CrossLink documents to be automatically generated in eTMF based on eCOA end-of-study participant data. Documents are related to the study, study country, and study site record originally transferred from Clinical Operations to eCOA.

This feature enables the distribution of CRM metadata for use with CLM and Events Management over the standard Medical-CRM Veeva connection. The features built as part of this integration will support the new Content Supply Chain. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Medical-Quality Connection: Transfer of Product Quality Complaints from Medical to Quality
description: Veeva Medical now supports the automatic transfer of potential Product Quality Complaints (PQCs) raised in Veeva Medical to Veeva Quality. PQCs are sent via a Vault-to-Vault (V2V) connection with all relevant product, event, and reporter information required for the Quality Complaint Intake process.

This feature includes enhancements to prevent Event Reaction and Event Product records from being edited when the Event has been transferred to Safety, and to schedule a connection pull when the Last Successful Run Time is modified.
This connection now transfers product-related data from PromoMats to Vault CRM via the standard Vault to Vault connection. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

This feature enables the distribution of CRM metadata for use with CLM and Events Management over the standard PromoMats-CRM Veeva connection. The features built as part of this integration will support the new Content Supply Chain. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: Provision Standard Product Family & Variant Field Rules
description: Standard field rules have been added in order to populate both Product Family and Product Variant on QMS Reported Product created via the integration to Safety.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Requires Correction State for Change Item
description: This new Change Item state will be available to regulatory users when assessing Enhanced Change Control Items from QMS. If mistakes are identified in the Change Control or Change Items the state can be selected to notify the QMS team corrections are needed prior to completing the assessment.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: Follow-Up & Single Intake Creation Logic
description: Single Intake Creation introduces logic to create one complaint intake based on the safety case assessments created. Additional enhancements include follow-up logic marking a Complaint Intake as Follow-Up, relating the Follow-up Intake to prior Complaint Intake & applicable Complaint(s).

feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Transfer All Valid Registrations
description: With this release, the Safety-RIM Connection handles Registration data synchronization failures caused by agency-related validation issues, and transfers all other valid Registrations.

feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Reflect Accurate Deletions in Safety Vaults
description: For Safety records linked to multiple join records in RIM, Vault now clears only the record’s associated fields when the most-recently synched join record is deleted in the RIM Vault.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Updates to Submission Tracking for Clinical Trials
description: Regulatory data entered in RIM will populate a new milestone type in Veeva Clinical Vaults used to track EU CTR Country Approval. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Submission Tracking. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Improvements for Study Drug Mapping & Significance Criteria
description: This feature updates device and gestation mapping and Inbox Item significance criteria, and adds support for Date and time on the Date of Death field, improved LMP support, and custom field mapping to Reason Omitted fields. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: Allow Unknowns & Time for Date of Death" (25R3-079001) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Setting Product in Clinical Operations
description: With this feature, Admins can configure their Vault to populate the Product in Crosslink documents generated in Clinical Operation Vaults based on Safety Letter and Cover Letter distribution data transferred from the Safety Vault.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Match Countries Based on Code
description: When setting a Country of Origin on a Safety Distribution in Clinical Operations, the system can now set the Country based on a matching 2 character country code from Safety.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Auto-Create System Links
description: Site Connect now automatically creates system links for Veeva EDC when EDC is used on a connected study.

feature: RTSM-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Create System Links
description: Site Connect now automatically creates system links for Veeva RTSM when RTSM is used on a connected study.

feature: eCOA-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Create System Links
description: Site Connect now automatically creates system links for Veeva eCOA when eCOA is used on a connected study.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Create System Links
description: Site Connect now automatically creates system links for Veeva Study Training when Study Training is used on a connected study.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Add Differentiated Security Profiles
description: This feature allows Sponsors/CROs to define which Security Profiles should be used for which User when they are auto-created in Study Training.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Sync Clinical User Status in Study Training
description: This feature enables Clinical User “status” sync to Study Training so there’s a common treatment of Global Directory.
This feature locks the Actual Finish Date field on site-level automated enrollment milestones to prevent manual edits when a study is configured for Date-Based Metrics.

feature: Bulk Copy Issue to Multiple Subjects
description: The Bulk Copy Issue action allows users to copy an Issue record to multiple Subjects in bulk.

feature: Recruitment Planning: Additional Metrics Over Time
description: Metric Types now includes the Consented and Started Treatment in the supported Recruitment planning scope.

feature: SDV Status Support for Subject Visits
description: Subject Visits have been updated to include SDV Status and DMR Status details.

feature: UI Enhancements for the Study Enrollment Status Graph
description: The Study Enrollment Status graph on the Study Manager and CRA Homepages now has a Subject Group filter. Additionally, forecasted metrics over time values will now display when they have been captured on a study.

feature: Enhance No Subjects Enrolled Trigger Logic to Include Deleted in CDMS Status
description: The No Subjects Enrolled trigger logic now correctly accounts for the Deleted in CDMS subject status.

feature: Refine Auto-Populate Last Subject Treated, Started Follow-Up, & Out Milestone Logic
description: Accuracy is improved for automated Last Subject Treated, Last Subject Started Follow Up, and Last Subject Out milestone completion by including additional terming status as part of the logic. The Actual Finish Date populates for Sites marked with No New Subject once the Subjects have reached a terminal status.

feature: Efficiencies for SDR Item Creation & Management
description: Vault automatically generates an SDR Item when a Subject Visit is marked Required and an approved SDR Plan exists. Subsequently, marking that SDR Item as complete automatically updates the Subject Visit's review status to Yes.
Users can now log Activities with multiple Attendees and referencing multiple studies by logging Discussions.

feature: Subject Group & SDV Status in Monitored Subject Data
description: Monitoring Event Seeding actions have been updated to include Subject Group details and SDV Status. Subject Group details are included on Monitored Subjects and Monitored Subject Visits. SDV Status is included in Monitored Subject Visits.

feature: Updated Seeding Logic for Closed Issues in Monitoring
description: The Seed Issues system action now considers the Date Identified field on Issue records instead of the Created Date when seeding closed Issues.

feature: New Generate Risk Mitigation Actions Per Study Job
description: The Generate Risk Mitigation Actions Per Study job now queues Risk Mitigation Action creation on a Study by Study basis.

feature: New Study Field for Pediatric Studies
description: The Study object now includes the new Pediatric Trial (pediatric_trial__v) field.
Vault can now merge duplicate Person records directly from the UI using the Merge Person object action.

application: CTMS, OpenData Clinical, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Autofill Site Timezones from Global Directory
description: When creating or updating a site record in CTMS, the timezone now automatically populates with the site's location's timezone. This value can be overridden by the user.

feature: Auto-Populate Last PSV Date on Location
description: This feature introduces new automation to populate the last_psv_date__v field on the location__v object based on the completion of a PSV Milestone for a Study Site where the location__v is listed as the primary location. This can be used to streamline or bypass PSV visits for locations that are used for multiple studies.

For Vaults with EDL Template Refactor enabled, a new user action is available to update Studies with the latest changes from their Template EDL. This action creates missing EDLs, Expected Documents, and Milestone Items for open Milestones so that studies stay aligned with the current standards.

EDL Automation is now automatically enabled with the EDL Template Refactor setting. As a result, the separate Enable EDL Automation setting has been removed to streamline the settings page and reduce confusion.

A new document panel displays Milestones linked to document versions via the Milestone Document object. The panel provides a more accessible alternative to the Milestone document field, allowing users to search, sort, and filter related Milestones and removing previous relationship limits. Related actions now also use this object.

For Vaults with EDL Template Refactor enabled, Admins can now use a setting to hide pre-EDL refactor actions from users. This simplifies the Action menu so that users are only presented with relevant options.

feature: Save Removal Preference for Expected Documents
description: Vault no longer re-adds Expected Documents that were manually removed from a Milestone, so that your Expected Documents remain accurate and you can avoid unnecessary rework. Users can still manually re-add these Expected Documents if needed.
Vault runs the Update Dependencies workflow when a Finish to Finish Milestone Dependency is created or when the system populates a Previous Milestone Date.

This feature enhances Milestone Date Offsets by supporting the update of Planned Dates of downstream (Next) Milestones when an Actual Start Date or Actual Finish Date is added to an upstream (Previous) Milestone.

feature: EDL Automation Respects Excluded Lifecycle States
description: Expected Documents for Study Persons, Study Products, and Study Organizations are no longer created when the Study, Study Country, or Study Site is in an Excluded Lifecycle State. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for EDL Automation and Excluded States for Milestone & EDL Creation. Other Vaults require configuration.

Override Template EDL Items now apply field updates such as Requiredness, # Expected, and Department on every EDL Item with the same match field values, regardless of milestone type. This removes the requirement to specify milestone types on override templates solely to apply field updates.

feature: Disclosures: Flexible Start Timing on Disclosure Rules & Re-order Arms
description: The new Start Date Shift value on Disclosure Rules allow Admin to control how early a Disclosure should be automatically created for Scheduled type Disclosure Rules.  Additionally, new ability to reorder Arms in the US Results Disclosure.

feature: Disclosures: Enhancements to Custom XML Generation
description: Users can now generate Custom XML for documents on the new Company Website Disclosure type, and include language field and rendition URL in Custom XML.
Users can now add comments within the Disclosure content for reviewers to view when moving through the Disclosure record.

feature: Disclosures: EU Initial CTA Form with Prepopulation
description: Veeva Disclosures now supports the Ability to support EU CTA - Initial Application Disclosure Type, including prepopulation. This Disclosure Type does not include the Part I Product Section.

feature: Disclosures: EU Notification Forms with Prepopulation
description: Veeva Disclosures now supports the Disclosure Types of Notifications for the EU, such as Recruitment Changes, Serious Breach, and Unexpected Circumstances.

feature: Move CTN Setting to New Disclosures Settings
description: The CTN settings are now located under the new Disclosure section.
