description: This feature improves E2B readable renditions by incorporating G.k.9.i and adverse event references within each product-specific G.k block, and embeds adverse event references within their corresponding product sections.
This feature allows users to reorder the Product Rank and Event Rank columns within the Medical Assessment section on the Case layouts.

feature: Follow-up Case Compare: Alphabetical Sorting for Manual Match Selector
description: This feature improves the Inbox Item to Case Compare page by sorting all picklist entries within the manual match selector in alphabetical order within their respective category sections.
Veeva Safety now displays non-current Japanese MedDRA Terms along with a recode badge.

feature: Company Product Match Verification for Deprecated Product Registrations
description: During Advanced Product Coding Verification, if the matched Product Registration is deprecated, Vault considers the Product Match Confidence to be an Unlikely Match.

feature: Always Open Multilingual MedDRA Browser in English
description: This feature introduces a setting that allows users to always display the multilingual MedDRA Browser in English.

feature: Duplicate Detection Subject Matching for Clinical Trial Cases
description: This feature introduces a Subject Matches section to group Inbox Items and Cases when duplicate detection is performed for Clinical Trial Study Types using the enhanced Potential Matches page.
This feature introduces single assessment generation for Product Quality Complaints (PQCs). Although this feature is Auto-on, some components may require additional configuration.
This feature introduces automatic domestic Localized Parent Information generation whenever parental information is manually added to a related global Case.
This feature supports IDMP MPID data within the WHODrug dictionary.
With this release, Vault re-maps NMPA-specific data whenever a Case Product is replaced or re-coded.

feature: PMDA MHLW Paper Form: Export Sender's Organization
description: This feature supports exporting the Organization of the User associated with the Sender (User) to Transmissions using PMDA MHLW Paper Forms.

feature: PMDA: Updating Assessments Following Global Approval
description: Veeva Safety now allows assessment changes on Japan domestic Cases to roll up to the global Case, regardless of the global Case’s lifecycle state.
This feature introduces the FDA Report Type field. In addition, when generating FDA E2B(R3) files, Vault references the FDA Report Type to map the required placeholder strings to the file.
This feature enhances data visibility within the Document Intake Highlighter panel.
This feature introduces an action that propagates all Substances in a Product Family to every Product within the family group.

feature: Field Access Updates for Potential Matches Page
description: With this feature, Vault displays the Reporter Qualification during Potential Matches review. Also, in Vaults configured with Case Access Group Security and with PHI and PII masking on the Potential Matches page, user Case Access Group permissions will be evaluated to provide appropriate PII access to fields on the enhanced Potential Matches page.
With this release, Vault converts date-based TermID Versions into the MMMddyyyy format for Vigiflow E2B(R3) exports.

feature: Case Version Compare: Improved Record Matching
description: This feature adds standard record-matching logic to the Case Version Compare page, which previously relied on only Link and Compare ID when comparing child records across Case versions.
This feature ensures that assessment generation is fully complete before Vault calculates reportability and deadlines.
This feature supports populating Expectedness Justifications on Japan Localized Case Assessments even when Case Adverse Events are Unexpected due to Serious Exclusions.
This feature updates data mapping to the E.i.4 and G.k.CN.4 data elements on NMPA E2B(R3) files.
This feature consolidates data from Safety and external sources, like FAERS and EVDAS, into one Statistical Data record.
This feature enables running calculations and case counts on data grouped by custom combinations of user-defined dimensions within Product Families.

feature: Calculations & Statistical Data Creation for VAERS
description: With this release, users can run calculations and execute statistical scores against VAERS data.

feature: Information Component Calculation for Signal Detection
description: This feature introduces the Information Component (IC) and IC-Bayes algorithms, along with IC025 and IC005 credibility intervals and the ability to select priors for signal detection. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components require additional configuration.

feature: Clearer Error Handling for EBGM Calculations
description: When EBGM score is unavailable or unreliable, the calculation now completes and a descriptive message is displayed in the Signal Calculation Run preview and on the Statistical Data record.

This feature introduces expiring ad hoc calculation results seven days after the calculation run, which also removes the Preview and Create Data actions for the calculation. Existing calculation run results will expire seven days after the version upgrade.
When opening a Signal Case Series in a Workbench Dashboard from a Statistical Data record, users must now apply filters before any data is displayed in the dashboard.

feature: Statistical Data Handling Based on MedDRA Version
description: This feature introduces a priority order when mapping a reaction event to the MedDRA dictionary on data creation from calculation results.
This feature introduces descriptive error messages for common configuration issues.

feature: Add Product Families to Aggregate Reporting Groups: Data Model
description: This feature introduces a join between Product-Family and Aggregate Report Group (ARG) to support Signal Calculation functionality.

feature: Signal Calculations for Product Family Combinations
description: This feature enables signal calculations at the Aggregate Reporting Group (ARG) level to support Signal Calculations and Signal Case Series generation across Product Families.

feature: Workbench PADER Simplified Registration Number Filtering
description: Workbench PADER will include cases with the specified registration number, instead of just matching to the the single registration record included in the filter. Multiple registration records can have the same registration number.

feature: Migrated Follow-Up Cases for Aggregate Reports
description: Veeva Safety Workbench aggregate reports, including PADER, DSUR, and PBRER, now support migrated historical cases.

feature: Combined Excel Export for Report Sets
description: This feature exports all reports in a report set into a combined Excel workbook.

feature: View Parameter Enhancements for Complex Reporting
description: This feature introduces optional parameters, combined date range parameters, and Excel tokens for embedding parameter values in templates.
This feature supports generating a report set and running multiple related reports simultaneously from a predefined report set definition.
This feature allows Admins to create a global corporate style template to reports.
This feature allows a user to create and import a Report Case Series from a CSV file.
This feature introduces the "not in" filter operator for reports for Object and Picklist field types.
This feature introduces a running status on Workbench Reports.
This feature introduces the Infinite Scroll option on Workbench Dashboard Components for viewing large datasets.
This feature allows Admins to preview SQL changes without finalizing view columns.
This feature introduces calendar filters to reports.
This feature supports using an Excel template across different Workbench Reports with similar safety views.

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
description: This release includes a number of standardizations across the Safety Suite, which include standard views for Signal, standard layouts for SafetyDocs, relabeled fields, and user-facing error messages for Signal.
This feature supports creating PVA Obligations before sponsor or partner contact information is known.

feature: PSMF: Display Document Title in PDF Table of Contents
description: This feature enables displaying document Titles in the table of contents of PSMF PDFs.
This feature introduces automated activity creation for monitored obligation events.

feature: Automated Inbound PVA Activity Email Processing
description: This feature automates the receipt and processing of inbound Pharmacovigilance Agreement (PVA) obligation activities and their related documents from partners.

feature: Support Multiple Reviewers During PSMF Periodic Review
description: This feature supports multiple reviewers for PSMF periodic reviews.
Admins can now restrict PSMF Logbook Entry editing and can require PSMF Logbook Entry before a PSMF document can move to the next lifecycle state.
Admins can now configure periodic reviews for PSMF Binders.

This feature updates Literature Integration to PubMed with weekly and monthly literature article search jobs, populating the URL on Literature Articles sourced from PubMed, and adds Search Term field warnings to Literature Search Terms.
Veeva SafetyDocs now supports up to 50 PSMF Logbook Entries per major version of a PSMF document.
With this feature, on the PV Agreement object the Make Agreement Documents Superseded action has been replaced by the Make Agreement Documents Terminated action.

feature: Clearer Error Handling When Generating PSMF PDFs
description: This feature introduces clearer error messaging for the Generate PSMF PDF action.

feature: Added Standard First Day of the Month Schedule
description: With this release, Veeva SafetyDocs now supports scheduled activities consistently recurring on the first day of the month.

feature: PVA: MAA Document Required for Distribution
description: Veeva SafetyDocs now requires a document when creating a PVA MAA Document for Distribution.

feature: Prevent Risk Measure Duplication on Local Implementation Strategies
description: This feature prevents the duplication of Risk Measures when the Create Local Implementations action is executed multiple times.

feature: Veeva AI for Safety: Intake Agent
description: In Vaults using Veeva AI for Safety, this feature introduces the Intake Agent, which processes structured and unstructured files to detect Adverse Event Reports (AERs) and generate Inbox Items.

feature: Veeva AI for Safety: Narrative Agent
description: In Vaults using Veeva AI for Safety, this feature introduces the Narrative Agent, which proofreads and rewrites rules-based narratives based on your Vault's configuration.

feature: Automatic Inbox Item Creation for Adverse Event Report Documents
description: This feature introduces automatic Inbox Item creation following upload of a Case > Source > Adverse Event Report document type to the Library.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Identify Programmatic Protocol Deviations
description: Protocol Deviations created in EDC through a Rule Definition are now identified as a Programmatic protocol deviation when created in CTMS through the connection.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Visit Review Progress Indication
description: This feature indicates whether SDV and DRM are in progress for Subject Visits, alongside existing statuses for SDV and DMR requiredness and completeness. This feature maps to the "Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Partial SDV and DMR Reflects as In Progress in CTMS" (26R1-07G005) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Editable Connection Details
description: Users can now edit default names and descriptions (among other details) for EDC connections, replacing numbered ones with clear names like "Connection to Sponsor A's EDC". This significantly improves organization and clarity within the Vault, helping users quickly identify each connection's purpose.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Flexible Visit Definitions
description: This feature helps CTMS and Payments users create their visit definitions early in their Clinical Vault by matching them on name when the study is connected, making it optional to manually link those records using private keys and IDs.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Inactivate Integration Record
description: This feature inactivates the legacy Study Registration Integration record and removes all associated code references.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Handling Child Details in Pregnancy Cases
description: This feature allows for the pregnancy case child details to be enterable in EDC after the birth of the child(ren) and transfer the child details to Safety as a follow-up to the original pregnancy case. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: New Standard Safety Fields & Configuration Restrictions" (26R1-07N015) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Improvements & Additional Mapping Support
description: When transferring data through the Safety-EDC Connection, Dechallenge data from EDC now updates the Dechallenge Override field on Case Assessments, ConMed and study drug details are now sent from EDC, and more pregnancy data is mapped from EDC to Inbox Items and Cases. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: New Standard Safety Fields & Configuration Restrictions" (26R1-07N015) feature in the CDMS RIA.

When transferring data through the Safety-EDC Connection, Vault now allows Product Indication information to be included and creates Case Assessment records for each. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: New Standard Safety Fields & Configuration Restrictions" (26R1-07N015) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Send Additional SAE Reporter Details to Safety
description: With this release, reporter email address and telephone values are now included when transferring SAE reporter contact information to Safety Vaults through the Safety-EDC Connection. This feature maps to the "Safety Integrations: Reporter details with new source, email and phone" (26R1-07M001) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Support Case Product Type Changes
description: This feature supports the changing of a Product Type dynamically when a product from EDC is changed to match products of different types.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Improved User Error Messages
description: User Exception Items (UEI) related to the Safety-EDC Connection include Study details and support LongText failures.
Vault updates unpromoted Inbox Items to Superseded state upon receipt of a follow-up Inbox Item for the same event.
The Add Relevant Subject Information dialog displays an error message when users do not have Create permission for the underlying object.

feature: eCOA-Clinical Operations Connection: Study Design Specification
description: When a customer has both Veeva eCOA and Veeva Clinical Operations, the Study Design Specification document that is generated by Veeva eCOA can be automatically filed into the eTMF of a connected Study as a representation of the study build. Document is automatically update each time a new collection is approved.

The new CRM Country Integration optimizes the standard Vault-to-Vault connection between Vault CRM and Medical Vaults. By making Medical Vaults "country-aware", this integration ensures that document updates only trigger notifications to the specific CRM Vaults associated with those countries to ensure data relevancy across your Vault environment. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

The CLM Integration streamlines the management and distribution of digital content by synchronizing Medical Vault documents with Vault CRM. This integration automates the creation and updating of Multichannel Presentations and metadata, ensuring that field representatives always have access to the latest approved materials. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

application: MedComms, MedInquiry, RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
description: This feature allows the transfer of product data between RIM and Medical to have a single source of truth. RIM is the source for product, indication, and local product data.
When configured, documents that reach their Steady State in RIM are created as CrossLinks in Medical. Subsequent updates to the Steady State document will be reflected on the CrossLink.

The new CRM Country Integration optimizes the standard Vault-to-Vault connection between Vault CRM and PromoMats Vaults. By making PromoMats Vaults "country-aware", this integration ensures that document updates only trigger notifications to the specific CRM Vaults associated with those countries to ensure data relevancy across your Vault environment. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

The CLM Integration streamlines the management and distribution of digital content by synchronizing PromoMats Vault documents with Vault CRM. This integration automates the creation and updating of Multichannel Presentations and metadata, ensuring that field representatives always have access to the latest approved materials. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: RIM-PromoMats Connection: AdPromo Submission Performance Improvements
description: The RIM-PromoMats AdPromo Submission feature is refactored and its complex CrossLink Post Processing is broken down into smaller, trackable jobs for improved error handling and faster performance.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Ensure QMS RCI & RAI Update Correctly
description: Quality-RIM ECC integration has been enhanced to ensure the QMS Regulatory Change Item records are updated when the corresponding RIM Change Item records are modified by either a user or system.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: User Exception Item Enhancement
description: This enhancement improves the user exception item, adding the Safety Case ID to the UEI Item Data field.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Material Change Object Type on Regulatory Change Item
description: This feature contains the data model changes needed specifically for the Regulatory Change Item QMS object and serves as a precursor to expanding the enhanced change control integration to support changes at the Material level.

application: QMS, RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
description: This feature enhances the existing Quality-RIM Connection's Product Data feature to include the Materials Data needed for Enhanced Change Control. This include Packaging, Containers, Active Substances, Inactive Ingredients, and related object relationships.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive, Safety
feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Updated Product Dose Form Syncing
description: This feature supports tagging a single Product’s dosage forms as either the global preferred term or a country-specific exception and introduces the Product Manufactured Dosage Form object to Safety Vaults, which supports tracking multiple dosage forms for a single Product.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive, Safety
description: The Safety-RIM Product Data Connection now supports the automatic transfer and alignment of co-packaged products, with Vault creating Safety Combination Products from the RIM Packaging object.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive, Safety
description: With this feature, following substance information transferred through the Safety-RIM Product Data Connection, Vault now updates all Products in a Product Family with the Product Family Substance details received from RIM.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Update to CrossLink Trigger Logic
description: RIM source documents in the Steady State now trigger the RIM-Clinical Operations Connection and create new CrossLinks in Veeva Clinical.

feature: Veeva Safety: Integration Stats for Safety Connections
description: With this release, Safety leverages a new platform framework to surface Integration Statistics directly within Vault.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: SCORM File Transfer
description: The Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection transfers functional SCORM files from Clinical Operations to Study Training.

feature: Remove Reliance on Risk Library for Study Specific Risk Assessments
description: Users can now conduct Study Risk Assessments in CTMS without relying on the Risk, Critical Process, or Risk Mitigation libraries to develop study-specific risks and considerations.

feature: Critical to Quality (CtQ) Factors Support for RBQM
description: Users can now track and manage CtQ factor in Study Risk Assessments, link CtQ to Critical Processes and Data for full traceability, and automate setup via the updated Generate Risk Assessment action, which pulls CTQ factors from Risk templates or existing Study Risk Assessments.

feature: Additive SDV Supported in Monitoring Event Subject Visit Seeding Logic
description: The Proactively Seed Monitored Enrollment & Seed Monitored enrollment action supports seeding Additive SDV data into Monitored Visits. The logic for seeding Subject Visits includes checking if Additive SDV has been performed.
Monitoring Event Question Status Badges support CRAs in identifying outstanding required questions in Question Sections while a Monitoring Event is in progress.
CTMS Transfer includes Study Site Addresses so that Sponsors can manage drug shipping addresses from CROs to drive drug shipment.

feature: Monitoring Event Seeding Respects Previous Monitoring Event of Same Content Type
description: The Monitoring Event Seeding actions respect the previous Monitoring Event of the same Content type.

feature: Monitoring Event Follow Up Item Seeding Logic Updates
description: The Seed Monitoring Follow-Up Items action on Monitoring Events now considers the Open Date on Follow Up Item's when seeding closed Follow Up Items into Monitoring Events.

feature: Protocol Deviation Subject Visit Context Improvement
description: A new Visit lookup field on Issue records displays user-friendly Subject Visit Definitions instead of system record names.

feature: Move CTN Setting Back to CTMS Settings
description: Admins can now enable the CTN Setting in the CTMS section of the Admin Settings page.

feature: Added More Standard Fields for Study Phase
description: Vault now includes additional standard values as inactive options in the Study Phase picklist. Admins must activate these values to enable triggers, prepopulation, and rules functionality for Disclosures. In addition, Expanded Access has been added as an inactive option to the Study Design Type picklist.

application: CTMS, Disclosures, Payments, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Support Localized Number Formatting for App Pages
description: This feature ensures that numbers, currencies, and percentages are displayed and edited using the appropriate format of a user's locale, including the correct decimal and grouping separators.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Prevent Creation of New Adobe Formatted Outputs
description: All new formatted output templates now leverage the Word functionality and no new Adobe templates can be created. Existing Adobe templates can continue to be edited.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: EDL Override Support for Site Connect
description: EDL Override templates update Site Connect fields on Expected Documents, such as Send using Site Connect, Auto-request from Site, and Sponsor/CRO Comments. This enables country-specific tailoring of Site Connect processes.

feature: New Standard Milestone Types: First IP Received, Operational Closeouts & Sample Testing
description: This feature introduces seven new standard values to the Milestone Type picklist: IP Received at Site, Country Operational Closeout, Study Operational Closeout, First Sample Received, First Sample Tested, Last Sample Received, and Last Sample Tested.

Users can visualize Study, Study Country, and Study Site progression in Process Monitor using Milestones. Users can select new standard processes to measure and visualize study progression based on the Milestone Actual Finish Dates.

Admins can now use the Block Rollup Dates multi-select picklist on Template Milestone and Milestone objects. This allows Admins to block specific Baseline or Planned dates from rolling up, providing more granular control over rollup functionality.
In Vaults with finish to finish dependency and date offsets enabled, the system now pulls in downstream dates when an upstream date is earlier, enabling more accurate trial planning.
The previous five minute delay has been reduced for Milestone Document Creation ensuring more accurate, real-time information.

feature: Sticky Header Support for List View of Milestones
description: Users now experience sticky header and freeze column capabilities when interacting with Milestone records in list view in Vault.

Admins can now configure formatted outputs for a Disclosure record, allowing users to download a PDF or printable version, or automatically save the file to Vault. This is available for EU and US Registrations and Results.

feature: Validate Action on US Registrations Using API
description: Admins can now configure the Validate action for US Registrations in all Lifecycle States. This allows users to view validation errors directly on Disclosure records, replacing the existing CSV report method.
Vault now bypasses validation for US Registration Site Lists when the associated Study Type is Observational or Expanded Access. Vault can now also trigger disclosures for Expanded Access studies.

feature: Disclosures US Results: Add Notes & NA Explanations
description: Users editing US Results can now mark a number field as NA and provide an explanation. Users can now also provide units, and add notes (comments) to the Participant Flow Milestone table.

feature: Disclosures US Results: Outcome Measure Enhancements
description: Users editing US Results can now define different arms and units per outcome measure, or select Results Not Ready and add an Anticipated Date. Users can now re-order Outcome Measures.
Users can now use a global directory search component to populate Organization and Contact information fields on US and EU Disclosure forms.
Vault now provides the framework for users to implement a periodic TMF QC process to ensure content is inspection ready.

feature: Prevent Modifications on Archive Snapshot Documents
description: Users cannot unarchive or edit snapshots that Vault created as part of the study archival process.

feature: Global Directory to OpenData Clinical Matching
description: Vault can now automatically generate Data Change Requests (DCRs) to streamline matching Investigator and Institution/Site records to OpenData Clinical. Using a new DCR Type, matching requests are routed to Veeva, and once matched, OpenData IDs return to the Vault to be applied to records.

feature: Display Preferred Affiliation in OpenData Clinical Details
description: Users can now designate a preferred or primary Contact Information for an OpenData Clinical Investigator. The preferred contact details appear in the Investigator OpenData Clinical Details section.

feature: Local Language Name & Address Details in OpenData Clinical
description: OpenData Clinical now delivers and controls Local Language fields for applicable Investigators and Sites. This update adds new fields, updates delivered records, and enhances Data Change Request functionality to support local language field change requests.

feature: Support for Investigators Without Site Affiliations
description: Vault now supports the inclusion of OpenData Clinical investigator records without confirmed site affiliations.

feature: Primary Country for OpenData Clinical Investigators
description: OpenData Clinical now delivers and populates the Primary Country field on an Investigator based on their primary site affiliation.

feature: Set OpenData ID in Record View Mode
description: For Investigator or Institution records that are not mapped to OpenData Clinical, users with appropriate permissions can now select the Set OpenData ID action directly from the record's View mode. Previously, the record had to be in Edit mode to select Set OpenData ID.
This feature ensures data consistency for Vaults with OpenData Clinical enabled during the transition to a new relationship between Prior Contact Information records and Contact Information records.

feature: OpenData Clinical Investigator & Site Search Improvements
description: Improved search capabilities now provide a more streamlined experience when browsing OpenData Clinical Investigators and Sites. Searched terms now deliver narrower results and optimized record ordering when searching by name and city.
This Payments functionality allows users to build Fee Schedules from underlying costs. Visit costs can be constructed from Procedures, as well as defining other cost elements.
This Payments functionality allow users to building Fee Schedules from underlying costs. Users can construct Visit costs from Procedures, as well as define other cost elements.
The system populates Unit Cost, and Upper Limit values in the Fee Schedule Template Builder from matching Procedure Reference Costs and Site Fee Reference Costs when building country-level templates.
Users can manage and track Site Clinical Trial Agreements (CTA) between sites and sponsors by directly linking Contract records with the corresponding documents and Site Fee Schedules.

feature: Generate Payable Items Supports Multi-Record Workflow
description: The Generate Payable Items action can now be initiated in a multi-record workflow.
Payments rounds calculated overhead, holdback, and tax amounts values based on the currency's minor units (decimal places) for currencies other than JPY and KWD.

feature: Tax Rates: Calculating Tax Rate Total Value
description: Payments users utilizing the Tax Rate object have the Total value updated automatically if they update the component tax fields of the Tax Rate object. Additionally, all Tax Rate percentage fields support values of four decimal points.
This feature enables Admins to configure the available Site Connect document action that a user can select when exchanging documents.
Using the acknowledgment details on the Distribution Task, site users can now download the acknowledgment information for all Safety Distributions.

This feature introduces a Study Site Plan which provides a collaborative workspace within Vault that allows Sponsors/CROs and Sites to establish, align on, and measure against standardized metrics and milestones.
This feature secures the four payments document types ensuring that only site users with the "Manage Site Reimbursement" responsibility are able to view those documents.
With this feature, Admins can waive acknowledgment for specific Safety Distributions for a given country.

feature: Prevent Document Reconciliation on Non-Connected Sites
description: The Document Reconciliation job does not run on sites that are not actively connected to SiteVault.

This feature introduces a daily summary email for document exchange notifications, including recall notifications. Site users with the Manage Essential Documents responsibility now receive one daily email notification per sponsor/CRO they work with.

This enhancement updates the hover text visible on the site record when a site is connected to SiteVault within the Sponsor/CRO view. Additionally, the search bar in Site Home has been optimized for small browser windows.
When downloading Safety Documents, this feature ensures that the download file name is consistant between authenticated document links and email links.

feature: Update Email Details after Document View
description: This enhancement updates the Email Details field when the email status on the Distribution Task Recipient record is marked as viewed.

In Vaults with the Milestone Study Country and Milestone Study Site feature enabled, the system now automatically connects a central application milestone to site level approvals through a finish to finish dependency. The feature also ensures when duplicate milestones exist, only milestone items for the specified milestone are created or removed.

In Vaults with the Milestone Planning View enabled, the page now supports projections and a timeline redraw before saving, along with user experience enhancements. These UX enhancements include additional filtering, page zooming, and icon indications for related milestone features like roll-up dependencies and Site Connect's Study Plan.

feature: Include Current Day in the Study Document Audit Export
description: Vault now includes audit entries for the current day when users export the full Study Document Audit Trail and includes today in the date selection.
The Replace User action on the Person object re-associates Users with their target Person record, eliminating manual work to merge duplicate users.
Vault automatically generates an uneditable Training Matrix Snapshot PDF each time a Training Admin publishes the Study Training Matrix.

Training Admins can export a Training Matrix to a formatted Excel file to add or remove Learner Roles or Training Requirements and update checkbox mappings in a familiar grid interface, then import the file back to a draft matrix to apply changes in bulk.

feature: Update Training Assignments Job Performance Improvements
description: Performance improvements to the Update Training Assignments job reduce logging and loops to increase processing speed.

feature: My Study Team: Individual Learner Page View
description: Clicking a Learner's card on the My Study Team page displays a new page with a comprehensive view of the Learner’s open, completed, and all Training Assignments.

feature: Study Training Matrix Builder Edit Menu Change
description: The Study Training Matrix Builder's Actions menu is updated to relocate the Edit and Delete buttons.

feature: PromoMats: CLM Slide Comparison User Interface
description: As a part of the CLM Publishing update, Vault automatically identifies revisions in a new side-by-side comparison view when a new version is uploaded. This user interface allows users to quickly approve the new version or make any necessary modifications before the presentation is synchronized in Vault CRM.
This feature provides a new method of CLM Publishing to Vault CRM to support the content supply chain.
This feature enables PromoMats users to manage and understand content rights by treating License and Consent Files as standard documents with standard lifecycles.

A new References section replaces the legacy References section in the Claims layout and provides additional details for each Reference, including the anchor title and the lifecycle state and document type of the document. It also enables key functionality such as editable columns and commenting.

feature: Claims: Entry Criteria to Validate References Are in Steady State
description: This feature introduces an entry criteria that users can apply to the Text Asset Lifecycle to validate that a Claim's associated Reference documents are all in a steady state.

feature: Claims: Remove Auto-Link on Initial Upload Flag
description: This feature removes the existing Auto-Link on Initial Upload Admin checkbox as it has been replaced by the Text Asset Auto-Linking Settings page.
The Auto-Linking status is available in the app-specific Document Readiness Panel.
A view called Reviewer Queue is now available on the Home tab. Reviewer Queue auto-prioritizes tasks to provide a more guided experience for Reviewers.

This feature surfaces high-level CLM engagement metrics directly in Portals to help teams understand how approved content is being used. Metrics are read-only, time-bounded, and intended for quick assessment for guiding reuse decisions.

This feature improves the administration of Text Asset records by updating the existing deletion rules for Text Assets. Deleting the parent Text Asset record now results in the deletion of standard child records, in a single action.

feature: Claims: Text Asset Auto-Linking Settings Enhancements
description: This feature extends the existing Auto-Linking Lifecycle States settings to also trigger Auto-Linking automatically when a document transitions into a configured state.
This feature improves how similarity scores are calculated, leading to more predictable and reproducible scores.
Content Similarity Document Compare highlights the differences between two documents in the document viewer when the Content Similarity score meets a certain threshold.
eCTD Compliance Packages with the Include Linked References setting set to Yes are generated with redline annotations, and the Add Annotations from Vault Links Application setting has been removed.

Claims Agent identifies promotional claims in documents, contextually matching to existing claim records, and creates new claim records for any variations detected. This significantly reduces the effort to annotate claims, and automatically manages the variability of core claims.

feature: Quick Check Agent & Content Agent Enhancements
description: The Quick Check Agent now returns more precise findings with fewer false positives, presented as observations rather than verdicts. The Content Agent provides more reliable answers to regulatory questions, returning decisions to the reviewer. Both agents now respond in the reviewer's language. *Auto-on in Vaults configured for Veeva AI.
Retains Testing supports testing of samples from a specific production batch that are stored for later analysis and used to investigate potential future issues.

Reduced Testing allows application of a reduced set of Tests and Criteria to some Material batches rather than performing full testing on every incoming lot. Vault automates the selection of the appropriate testing plan based on pre-defined schedules, supplier qualification statuses, and the history of processed batches.

feature: Calculated Result Can Use Input Attributes
description: This feature allows a Test Definition to reference attribute values assigned to an Input at test evaluation and inject those values into formulas. For example, an HPLC assay calculation for a Result can now automatically pull the Standard Concentration attribute from the selected reagent lot record, eliminating manual transcription from a CoA.

feature: Calculated Result Can Use Input Amount
description: This feature allows Test Definitions to reference Inputs at Test evaluation and inject the Input's amount into formulas.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Formatting Options Now Editable
description: In the Spec Data Builder, the Result Format section on the Criteria card is now interactive, allowing admins to view and update the formatting options directly. While Notation defaults to Standard if unspecified, the other fields can now be left blank. Admins can also choose to populate specific valid combinations.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Option to Edit Fields on Sample Action
description: For Select Actions, the UI now includes an Edit Metadata button which opens the specific Action record in a new browser tab, allowing the user to quickly set metadata field values without cluttering the main Builder interface. Additionally, the Reported Name field is now visible and editable on the Test Action card within the Spec Data Builder.

feature: Apply Default Filter for Owning Site
description: This feature introduces automatic, default site-based filtering across LIMS-controlled screens based on a user's assigned organizational location.

feature: Test Definition: Formatting Options Can Be Optional
description: Previously, LIMS enforced Precision Type and Precision Number as required fields via standard validation rules. This feature allows Admins to inactivate these rules and thus save a Result or Variation Result without applying formatting rules.
This feature allows Design Data Admins to display detailed product specification descriptions to Lab Analysts directly within the Test Execution and Sample Results Entry (SRE) UI.

Spec Data Builder now allows Design Data Admins to configure various chart types, including control charts and regression analysis, directly through a centralized interface. Previously, this option was not possible through the Design Data Builder UI.

This feature expands on LOD & LOQ with an Upper Level of Quantification (ULOQ). While LOD & LOQ cover the smaller range of possible measurement values, ULOQ provides the means to change how measurements above acceptable ranges are reported, displayed, and calculated.

feature: Stability Study: Create Copy of Sample Plan & Spec Data
description: The Generate Lab Study and Generate Lab Study Timepoint actions now have a new option: Create Copy of Sample Plan and Spec Data. When selected, a new copy of the Sample Plan and Spec Data is used for each Timepoint.
The Stability Study Builder introduces a purpose-built, top-down user experience for authoring, editing, and managing Stability Protocols and Study Designs.

Analysts can now perform Tests outside the scope of Batch Release and Stability Studies. They can create Non-Routine Spec Data for business processes such as cleaning or method validation as well as define Ad Hoc Tests for more freeform supplementary testing, and also initiate Non-Routine and Ad Hoc Testing by creating a Request record.

Ad Hoc Criteria allow users to assign temporary, batch-specific acceptance criteria to unplanned Tests without modifying standard Spec Data. This enables pass/fail evaluation and COA reporting for one-off investigations or client-provided Test requests at runtime.

This update adds five standard fields to the Spec Data Sample Action object and introduces a lifecycle to the Lab Consumable Family object. Additionally, the Minimum, Maximum, and Decimal fields are now editable on the Lab Test Definition Input, Lab Test Definition Variation Input, and Lab Test Input objects.
If Expected Amount is left blank in a Test Definition, it does not appear as Required in the Test Definition Preview.
This feature standardizes common Asset and Consumable data model components in Veeva LIMS by introducing standard objects, fields, lifecycles, and workflows.

feature: Test Definition Input & Test Input: Amount Field Update
description: Users can now edit Expected Amount and Amount decimal places on Lab Test Definition Input and Lab Test Input Object.
This feature adds a standard lifecycle to the Lab Consumable Family object.

feature: Stability Study: Date/Time Fields for Pull Window
description: The following Date/Time fields are available on the Study Timepoint and Lab Sample objects: Earliest Pull Date/Time, Latest Pull Date/Time, Scheduled Start Date/Time (Study Timepoint object only). Additionally, the Hours and Minutes values are now available on the Unit picklist.
The "User must always enter a value (required)" setting is now editable on the Time Stored and Time Stored Units fields on the Lab Study Design Timepoint and Lab Study Timepoint objects.
The No More Than picklist value is now available as an entry option and formatted value for the LOD Entry Option picklist.

feature: Test Definition & Spec Data: Updated Formatting Options Validation Method
description: The following valid states for formatting options on a Result or Criteria are now available for triggers and Change Analysis checks:  Rounding Rule, Precision, Precision Type, and Precision Rule all have data OR Rounding Rule and Precision Rule have data OR Precision and Precision Type are both blank or both populated.
Documents in Test Execution and Test Definition Builder can be popped out and viewed in a separate browser tab.
Spec Execution records now include a new field that tracks the date and time when the execution was initiated.

feature: Test Execution: Updated Exception Icon Hover Display
description: The existing Criteria icon hover tooltip has been redesigned to prevent text from clipping off the screen. The new tooltip shows a maximum of three criteria, truncates descriptions on the third line, and includes a new View Details link that opens a dialog containing the full text for all applicable Criteria.

feature: Reduced Testing: Obsolete Field & Object Inactivation
description: Vault now inactivates obsolete fields and objects replaced by the new Reduced Testing feature. This includes the Reduced Testing Frequency, Reduced Testing Interval, Include in Reduced Testing, and Full Testing fields, as well as the Material Supplier object.

feature: Print Label: Label Definition is Searchable
description: Users can now further filter the list of Label Definitions on Print Label actions. Previously, the field was a dropdown with no search capabilities.

feature: Stability Spec Execution: No Notification for Missing Batch
description: When a Stability Spec Execution is initiated, LIMS does not send a notification that the batch is missing.

feature: Show Input Name in Test Execution
description: In Test Execution, the configured Input name is now be displayed to the user. Previously, the Input's Family Name was displayed.

feature: Stability T0 Import: Default Sample Type to Release
description: In the T0 import dialog, the Sample Type column filter is now automatically set to Release.

feature: Scientific Statements: Entry Criteria to Validate References Are in Steady State
description: This feature introduces an entry criteria that can be applied to the Scientific Statement Lifecycle to validate that a Scientific Statement's associated Reference documents are all in steady state.

feature: Scientific Statements: Auto-Linking in Readiness Panel
description: The Auto-Linking status is available in the app-specific Document Readiness Panel.

References for Scientific Statements can be managed directly from the Scientific Communication Platform (SCP) UI. The new dialog allows users to add or remove references and anchors for each Scientific Statement.

This feature surfaces high-level CLM engagement and Portal usage metrics directly in Portals to help teams understand how approved content is being used. Metrics are read-only, time-bounded, and intended for quick assessment for guiding reuse decisions.

This feature improves the administration of Scientific Statement records by updating the existing deletion rules for Scientific Statements. Deleting the parent Scientific Statement record now results in the deletion of standard child records, in a single action.

feature: Scientific Statements: Extend Scope of Auto-Approve Statements
description: The existing Auto-Approve Statements document entry action is updated to allow configuration on non-steady document states and expand the eligible states for Statements to include those assigned to the Initial State state type.

feature: Enable Scientific Communication Platform UI in All MedComms Vaults
description: The Scientific Communication Platform (SCP) UI is enabled automatically for all MedComms Vaults. The Enable Communication Platform UI Application setting has been removed.
This feature enables Medical users to manage and understand content rights by treating License and Consent Files as standard documents with standard lifecycles.
The new Case Management User Interface includes a timeline panel to display inbound and outbound interactions alongside the Case and Case-related records.
The new Case Management User Interface allows users to view and manage Case and Case-related records on one page.

feature: Create Inbound Interactions from Ingested Emails
description: A new object is added to MedInquiry called Inbound Interaction, with object types for Email, Phone, and Chat. When emails are ingested into MedInquiry, an Inbound Interaction object of type Email is created.

feature: Update Component Security on Name Field on User Role Setup (Case) Object
description: The User Role Setup object now supports system-managed naming for the Name field. Record names can be configured to be automatically generated using a standardized sequence (for example, URS-MI-######).

This release includes a Platform enhancement that allows the Label, Output Format, and template file to be editable for standard Formatted Output templates, which were previously not editable. In MedInquiry, this applies to the Case Report for Attachment (case_report_for_attachment__v) template.

feature: Enhanced Logging for MedInquiry Email Intake
description: Admins are notified immediately when a Medical Inquiry email fails to ingest.
The Add/Remove Responses dialog allows users to see Case Responses that are not in the Ready for Fulfillment state.

To help automate Cases processing, the Case Processing Agent in the Case Management UI extracts information from Inbound Interactions and automatically creates Case Request, Adverse Event, and Product Quality Complaint records.
The Medical Product Agent infers the product details from unstructured text and provides the best matched records for the Product data model (Family, Form, Variant, and so on).

feature: Medical: CLM Slide Comparison User Interface
description: As a part of the CLM Publishing update, Vault automatically identifies revisions in a new side-by-side comparison view when a new version is uploaded. This user interface allows users to quickly approve the new version or make any necessary modifications before the presentation is synchronized in Vault CRM.
This feature provides a new method of CLM Publishing to Vault CRM to support the content supply chain.

Publications, part of the Vault Medical suite, is an application used to plan, author, review, approve, and submit scientific literature to journals and congresses. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Enforce Atomic Security in Audit Logs
description: When a user is restricted from seeing certain fields by Atomic Security, updates to these fields are hidden when the user views an individual object record audit trail. This enhancement does not impact Admin audit logs. *Auto-on for users with field restrictions by Atomic Security with access to view audit trails on object records.

feature: Notifications: Remove Multiple Email Addresses from Suppression List
description: Admins can now remove multiple email addresses from the suppression list in bulk.

The Vault user interface now automatically adjusts according to a user's available browser width, including collapsing sidebars to maximize space and adjusting field layouts to reduce horizontal scrolling. Users now also have an option to manually collapse sidebars. Additionally, Date/Time fields have a Now link to ease data entry.
When users click into the search bar on a Document tab, the documents shown in the dropdown for quick access now load faster and provide more relevant documents to users.
Users can now copy the link to a document or record using a standard keyboard shortcut.

Users now re-authenticate to Vault in a new window after being logged out due to inactivity, maintaining the page they were actively working on. When working in multiple Vaults on the same domain in different browser tabs or windows, activity in any Vault prevents timeout in all tabs or windows. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Add API Name to Document Type Details Object
description: A new field Document Type Name (document_type_name__v) field has been added to the Document Type Details (doc_type_detail__v) object so the public API name of the document type is more easily accessible.

feature: Collaborative Authoring Logs for OAuth Errors
description: The Microsoft Request ID is now included in Integration Status error messages displayed on the Admin > Settings > Checkout Settings page.

feature: Preview for Overlay & Signature Page Templates
description: Users can now preview edits to overlay and signature page templates before saving the template.

Admins can now configure templates to include links that launch or join collaborative authoring sessions directly from email notifications. This enhancement applies to notifications used in workflows that have the "Use workflow single document" box checked.

feature: Document Inbox Enhancements: Edit Document Type
description: Users can now save a document type classification for Incomplete documents in the Document Inbox without providing all the required document field information. Documents still need to be completed with all the required field values to be fully usable in the Library.

A new and improved document viewer is now available, which includes a simplified user experience with a streamlined document viewer toolbar, improved full screen viewing mode, split screen viewing mode, one-click version compare with AI Summary (for customers who have licensed Vault AI), and expanded zoom controls.
The Hierarchy Viewer now has a consistent experience for EDLs, EDL Items, EDL Templates, and EDL Item Templates.

feature: Collaborative Authoring: Increase Participant Limit for Automatic Mentioning
description: Users can now add 100 participants when starting a collaborative authoring session with a workflow action, and all participants are granted Write permission to the document. *Auto-on for Vaults configured to use automatic mentioning via workflows.

feature: Dynamic Styling for Claim-Based Link Annotations
description: Claim-based link annotations now display unique styling to reflect how the annotation was created, as well as the lifecycle state of the associated Claim record used in its creation. *Auto-on in Vaults with auto-claims linking enabled. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Make a Copy: Exclude Inactive Record Values
description: When using Make a Copy on a document, inactive object record values in an object reference field are no longer copied to the new document.

feature: Layout Profiles Supported in Action Triggers
description: Admins can now evaluate layout profiles in a condition and use update record actions to set a layout profile.

feature: Record Migration Mode for Delete Operations
description: Vault now supports record migration mode for delete operations, including the No Triggers option. This feature is supported for both Vault API and Vault Loader.

Admins can now configure object fields to be bound to a control. In the past, only layouts supported configuration of controls. Vault always displays a field with control binding using that control in detail pages, list pages, and related object sections.

This feature introduces a Bitmask field type for objects, enabling apps to securely filter records efficiently without performance degradations at high volumes. Bitmask fields can be created by Veeva only and support a new bitwise operator in VQL.

Admins can now create a pool of dynamic questions for each section in a Checklist Design. From this question pool, only a random subset of these dynamic questions is created in the instantiated checklist.

feature: Layout Profile: Summary Dialog for Adding & Removing Users
description: When adding or removing users from a Layout Profile, Vault now shows a summary dialog if any users were skipped. If all users were successfully added or removed, Vault continues to show a banner instead.

feature: Layout Rules: Automatic Controlled Field Management
description: Layout rules now automatically add controlled fields when their controlling field is hidden, and controlling fields when their controlled field is displayed as required. Auto-added fields are locked with a tooltip naming the dependency.

feature: Document Fields in Object Formula Fields
description: Object formula field expressions now support document fields.

feature: Word Formatted Output: Support for GetRelatedRecords Formula
description: Word Formatted Output now supports the GetRelatedRecords() formula to simplify creation of templates. This is most useful for showing a row or table only if a related record exists.

Vault now supports the Copy Link action for object records, allowing users to copy a clean and shortened URL for better sharing. The copied link automatically redirects users to the record detail page when pasted into a browser. This new action supports new shortcut keys.

When records are created, updated, or deleted in migration mode, related records changed in the same transaction by Record Triggers inherit many of the same migration mode behaviors. This inheritance is unchanged, and the audit trail for the related records now appends "in migration mode" in the event description.

feature: Download as PDF: Deduplicated Records in Related Join Object Sections
description: When using the Download as PDF functionality on object records, the generated PDF now consolidates duplicate records in the same manner as the Vault UI.

Vault now follows the International Components for Unicode (ICU) locale format for number fields. This feature ensures that numbers, currencies, and percentages are displayed and edited using the appropriate format of a user's locale, including the correct decimal separators and digit groupings.
The Where Used object action shows where a given object record is used across other objects and documents.

feature: File Count Validation for Record Attachments
description: Vault now informs users that they cannot drag and drop more than 100 files if they attempt to do so in a record detail page. Attempts to do this result in an error that none of the files have been uploaded.

The time picker in Vault UI now discards incomplete input or invalid values entered by the user. Previously, the time picker silently defaulted to the last known valid value when it could not interpret the user input, leading to confusing behaviors.
A Report Usage object is now available, allowing users to create reports on report runs.

feature: Exclude Inactive Users in Report Filters
description: Reports can now exclude inactive users from being available in filter and prompt dropdowns, either on a per-report basis, or for all reports.
The Create Report page has been improved to allow users to search available report types, see existing reports using report types, and see report type definitions.

feature: Support Multi-Object Reference Fields in Document Report Formulas
description: Reports now support using multi-value object reference fields as inputs to a Text function in a document report, which returns a list of object names separated by commas.
Process Monitor now provides an option to explore specific records or documents that are included in a process directly in the Process View itself.

A number of enhancements are introduced to aggregate functions in report formulas, including filtering within SumRows(), choosing at what level aggregates should display, supporting 15 aggregate functions in a single formula field, and expanding field type support. Additionally, aggregate functions can now be used in Matrix reports.
The Expand All option is now available for users to expand all groups in reports with more than 2,000 records.

feature: Support Workflow & Task Owner in Report Formula Fields
description: Users can now add Workflow Owner and Task Owner fields in multi-pass reports for both documents and object workflow reports.

feature: Add Description to Report Formula Fields
description: Users can now add descriptions to report formula fields, which are displayed as tooltips on the report formula field column headers in reports.

feature: Show Report Formula Fields as a Percentage
description: Users can now configure report formula fields for numbers to display as percentages.
Process Views now run in the background and notify users when the run is complete. The data is cached on a Process View for 24 hours.
When viewing a dashboard, users can now right-click on charts to open the underlying report in a new browser tab.
Users can now authenticate to the Vault API using long-lived tokens. This ability increases security and convenience.
Admins and developers can now monitor VQL query performance with the new query profiling tool. Query profiling allows Admins and developers to analyze and optimize their query execution.

feature: Packages Support for Record Attachments & Attachment Fields
description: Vault configuration migration packages now support exporting and importing record attachments and attachment field files.

Migration package validation now validates SDK compile errors and sub-component dependencies, and prevents deployment if errors are detected. Previously, users had to read the log file to view errors.
Admins can now use relative date functions that resolve to dates when scheduling jobs.
A new Archive action is now available for archiving documents in Date-Based Document Operation job types. This option is available for document jobs in Vaults with document archiving enabled.
This feature enhances the Connection Authorization workflow, specifically focusing on the input methods for API Key and Client Secret Auth Types.
Loader jobs now leverage the distributed job framework, which leads to faster load times for Vault datasets.

feature: Direct Data API: Additional Document Metadata in Workflow Extracts
description: This feature adds existing document and version VQL fields in Workflow Item and Task Item extracts.
Admins can now enable Vault AI in the Administration user interface. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Bring Your Own Model: Google Gemini Support
description: Vault AI includes support for custom LLM connections using Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash models.
Agent Action configuration now includes support for Viewable Rendition, API access control, and Document version selection.
Vault AI provides the ability to assign workflow tasks to agent users for task completion.

Vault AI Metadata describes Vault knowledge (objects and document types) for agents. Based on this knowledge, the agent can accurately interpret natural language instructions and execute them as application actions (for example, VQL queries) on physical components.
Vault AI agent tool configuration now supports a standard agent tool for generating a JSON output.
Vault AI now supports a new tool type that asks for user inputs in Vault AI Chat. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

Vault AI agents now support the Document Version Compare Agent, a platform-level agent that is designed to aid document comparison during version control. By comparing your current version against the previous major version, this agent provides a quick, high-level summary of key changes helping the user understand what to focus on.

Vault AI now supports natural language capabilities to retrieve and analyze Vault data. The Query Agent utilizes Vault AI metadata and multiple tools, while interacting with users to better understand their needs. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.
The Vault user interface now refers to Vault AI instead of Veeva AI.

feature: VeevaID Contextual Help for Personal Detail Updates
description: When VeevaID users update their personal details in the My Account tab, they are now required to provide acknowledgement that the changes they are making are correct.
Admins can now configure Qualification checks for market-ship decisions.
Admins can configure what disposition decisions require a disposition to be reviewed by exception.
Admins can now configure market specific document check requirements and item requirements.
Users can now use the Title field on the Disposition Autonumber object and can view the Title when populating the Parent Plan for a Disposition Plan.

When a user creates a disposition, they are taken to the newly created disposition with a banner displaying the status of Batch Disposition Item creation. When item creation is complete, the banner updates with a link to refresh the page and view the completed items.
Users can now open and close the Disposition details section on the Batch Disposition Execution Page.

application: Batch Release, HACCP, QMS, QualityDocs, Station Manager, Study Training, Surveillance, Training, Validation Management
feature: Display Application Configurations by Enabled Application
description: The links in the Application Configurations section on the Admin > Configuration page are now organized by application, and display according to the enabled applications in a Vault.

feature: HACCP Flow Diagram: Display Risk Category Field as Clickable Link
description: The Risk Category field in the Risk Assessment section of the Information panel now displays as a clickable link. Clicking the link opens the record in a small browser window.

feature: HACCP Flow Diagram: Intermediate State for Connections
description: Users are now prevented from making updates to a connection between two steps on the HACCP Flow Diagram while saving is in progress for any previous updates to that connection.

feature: HACCP Flow Diagram: Update to Label of Hazard Significance Filtering Option
description: In the Information panel, the label for the process hazard analysis filtering option under “Is Significant Hazard?” is now updated from “Insignificant” to "Non-significant".

feature: Reason for Change: Support for Test Plan & Effectiveness Check
description: Admins can now configure Vault to prompt users for a reason for change when modifying key fields on Test Plan and Effectiveness Check records.

feature: Qualification Support for LIMS & Batch Release
description: The data model is now enhanced to enable the use of qualification data for finished materials and testing decisions, providing foundational support for processes in LIMS and Batch Release.
Admins can now configure External Notifications for Complaints and Quality Events (Complaint and Medtech Complaint object types) to use the new Complaint Contact object.
Admins can now configure an application section that allows users to associate Batch records to a process record using pre-defined filters.

Audit Room now supports modifying state labels and adding state lanes. Additionally, Admins can now configure custom lifecycle states on the Inspection Request Lifecycle and display them in the Audit Room.
External Response Collaboration now supports the Inspection Request object, allowing users to collaborate with external contacts on Inspection Request records.

feature: Audit Room: Expanded Inspection Request Card
description: Admins can now configure Inspection Request cards in the Audit Room to display additional key fields, allowing users to review critical information about requests.
Admins can now configure the Send External Notification user action to display a preview of an email to users before sending.

feature: QRM: Create Risks from Existing Risk Assessment
description: Admins can now configure a new user action that allows users to create new Assessment Risks by copying data from existing Assessment Risk records.

feature: External Notifications: Support for Complaint Intake
description: External Notifications are now supported for the Complaint Intake object.
Users can now manage a manual Complaint Intake Follow-Up process with a new object and application sections.
Users can now manage information about contacts associated with a Complaint Intake with new objects, and display those contacts across associated Complaints with a new application section.

feature: Complaint Email Ingestion: Support for MedTech Complaint Intake Object Type
description: Complaint email ingestion now supports the MedTech Complaint Intake object type of the Complaint Intake object.
Admins can now configure External Notifications to send notifications in the  communication language specified on a Complaint Intake or Complaint record.

feature: External Notifications: Support for Email Document Attachments
description: Admins can now configure External Notifications to include documents as email attachments.

feature: QRM: Manage Related Documents in Risk Builder
description: Users can now add, modify, and view related documents for Assessment Risks from the Risk Builder interface.
Audit Room now supports adding and accessing multiple Scribe Notes related to an Inspection, allowing teams to organize documentation by day, inspector, or scope.

feature: Display Record Count for QMS Sections
description: This feature adds record counts for the following QMS Sections: Action Steps, Record History, Reason for Change History, Related Event, Risk Builder, and Notification Recipients.

feature: External Collaboration Checklists: Display Follow-Up Interface on Completed Checklists
description: Users can now view follow-up questions and responses on completed Supplier Questionnaires.

feature: Promote to Complaint Enhancement: Ignore Inactive Fields
description: The Promote to Complaint action no longer considers inactive fields when attempting to copy values from source Complaint Intake and Reported Product fields to any generated Complaints.

feature: Create Related Record: Copy Custom Fields for Referenced Records
description: When copying referenced records with Create Related Record, the feature now copies populated custom field values from the source referenced record to the target referenced record, ensuring that existing data takes precedence over default values.

Vault now prevents Admins from configuring system (__sys) objects as the source object in a Related Record Configuration. Additionally, the Create Related Record action now displays an error and does not create a related record if a configured source join object is inactive.

feature: Audit Room: Auto-Add Assignee to Fulfiller Role on Inspection Request
description: The Audit Room now supports automatically adding the user selected as the Assignee on an Inspection Request record to the Fulfiller role within that record’s Sharing Settings.

feature: Audit Room: Publish Inspection Request from Any Lifecycle State
description: Users can now publish Inspection Requests from any lifecycle state, removing the validation that required users to put an Inspection Request into the Fulfilled state prior to the Published state.
Users can now utilize Complaint Agent for Medtech Complaints to generate on-demand narrative summaries of investigations, and ask questions about the Complaint via the Vault AI Chat interface.

feature: Complaint Agent & Deviation Agent: User Experience Improvements
description: Users can now navigate away from records during Investigation and CAPA Plan narrative summary generation and review the generated summary upon return. This enhancement also improves the quality of the generated summaries, for example, removing references to owners. *Auto-on in Vaults configured for Vault AI.

feature: Cascade DCC Roles to Documents on Task Reassignment
description: Admins can now configure a workflow action to cascade document lifecycle role assignments down to the governed documents after tasks are reassigned in a Document Change Control (DCC) workflow.

feature: Document Change Control: Display Related Documents
description: Admins can now configure the Display Add Related Documents action in supported sections of the DCC setting, which enables allows users to add related documents to the Change Authorization, Documents to be made Effective with Workflows, and Documents to be made Obsolete with Workflows sections of a DCC.

feature: Periodic Review: Reassignment of Inactive Document Owner
description: Admins can now configure an action to reassign inactive owners on documents and periodic reviews, preventing periodic review jobs from failing.

feature: External Collaboration Enhancement: Data Model Update
description: The Display in Business Admin checkbox on the External Collaboration Reassign Tasks object configuration is now read-only and no longer editable.

feature: Document Change Control: Unlink Document Change Request & Periodic Review
description: Vault now automatically unlinks associated Document Change Request and Periodic Review records from a Document Change Control (DCC) record when the target documents are removed from the DCC.

feature: Document Change Request: Add Target Document Owner
description: Vault now automatically adds the Document Owner of the target document associated with a Document Change Request record to the Target Document Owner role in the Sharing Settings of the corresponding Document Change Request record.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel Enhancement: Support for Archived Documents
description: Vault now displays archived documents in the Document Relationships section of the Quality Relationships Panel. *Auto-on in Vaults configured for Document Archiving. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Process Navigator: Support Ten Dynamic Document Association Criteria Rules
description: Up to ten dynamic document association criteria rules can now be created for each process in Process Navigator.

feature: External Collaboration Enhancement: Display Veeva Quality Logo
description: Vault now displays the Veeva Quality logo on the steady state document that is sent to external collaborators via a secure public access link after the external collaboration has ended.

feature: Process Navigator Enhancement: Improve Object Reference Field Value Selection
description: Selecting object reference field values in the Process Navigator: Dynamic Association Criteria builder is now improved.

feature: Document Control Homepage Enhancement: Improve Object Reference Field Value Selection in Filter Criteria
description: Selecting object reference field values in the filter criteria of the Document Control Homepage is now improved.

feature: Process Navigator Enhancement: Support None Operator in Dynamic Document Associations
description: Users can now select values using the "Is none of the following" operator in Dynamic Document Association criteria rules in Process Navigator.

feature: QualityDocs & Station Manager Objects: Add Key Document Fields
description: Several QualityDocs and Station Manager objects now include standard, system-managed document fields, allowing users to view critical metadata directly on object records that reference a target document.

feature: Support Document Title in Station Manager
description: Station Manager now supports displaying the Document Title instead of the default Document Name in the Library View, Document View, and Document Information pages for both iOS and Android applications.

Updates were made to quiz icons shown to display correct and incorrect answers. The Training Requirement section of the Document Information Panel was updated to also include Training Requirement Impact Assessments.
Training Admins can set a Curriculum with Due Date fields, which Vault applies to all associated Training Requirements and resulting assignments. This feature is Auto-on with required configuration.
Learners can test out of training by passing a quiz before reviewing any Training Materials.
Training Admins can create a pool of questions from which Vault randomly selects a subset for each Learner attempt.

feature: Completion of E-Learning Completes Training Assignment
description: When a Learner completes an E-Learning (SCORM) course, Vault prompts them to populate their eSignature upon closing the SCORM player, then completes the assignment’s workflow task and marks the related Training Assignment as Complete.

feature: Optional Due Dates for Matrix Training
description: CONFIGURATION is needed for this feature to fully function. Training Admins can set Due Date fields within a Curriculum or Training Requirement such that any resulting assignments do not have a Due Date. This feature is Auto-on with required configuration.

The Curriculum Completion Status's Completion Percentage calculation has been updated to accurately calculate the completion percentage when a Learner has completed some Training Assignments for a Curriculum and the rest are canceled.

This feature generates the snapshot of the data used in the submission of AER to the health authorities. The UI uses this snapshot data once documents are generated *Auto-on in Vaults with the VPS: Generate Submission Documents action configured.
Admins can now configure and override the standard data mapping for health authority forms.
Users can now easily manage and select contact information (address, phone, email, and so on) for health authority reports.

Users can now populate Product Attributes Master Data (Brand Name, Product Description, Registration Numbers, and so on) directly from the Adverse Event Report object if Regional Product Attributes feature is enabled.

feature: VPS: Concomitant Products & Related AER Improvements
description: This feature introduces the ability to add free text for section H10 (related adverse events) in eMDR and Concomitant Products on Complaint.
CONFIGURATION is needed for this feature to fully function. A Training Admin can assign a Training Requirement directly to a Learner for integration into their Training Matrix.

Admins can now configure the Enable Copy Enhancements for Activities and Protocol setting, which enhances the deep copy process to ensure large hierarchies of validation records are copied seamlessly and without system timeouts, and improves error handling.

feature: Populate Validation Viewer Role on Validation Management Records
description: Users assigned the Validation Viewer application role are now populated and visible in the Sharing Settings on Validation Management object records.

This feature optimizes loading and saving in the test authoring interface, increases in the number of standard and additional prompts shown horizontally based upon screen resolution to align with other application pages, and introduces active error handling for simple field validations (required, max length, and so on).
RIM Publishing now supports publishing and validating Taiwan eCTD Submissions based on the version 2.0 DTD and validation criteria version 2.1

Admins can now populate organization specific guidance on the Additional Instructions field available on Validation Criteria, which is displayed per rule on the Submission Validation Results. A Veeva Help Text field is now available and is populated with Veeva specific guidance per validation rule.
The XML Operation is now automatically set to Append for previously submitted STFs for a specific Study ID.

feature: Set Reference Leaf Updates for eCTD 4.0 Support
description: The user can now use the Set Reference Leaf operation which will use Submission Archive's new API and components to display already submitted content that can be selected via the Set Reference Leaf Operation.

feature: Automatic On-Demand Validation for Submission Validation Version Changes
description: Users can now update the Validation Criteria Version changes on a Publishing Active submission and the system performs validation against the entire submission.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: HAQ Response Automations: Default Fields on Response Document
description: When utilizing the Initiate Response guided user flow to generate a Health Authority Response, Vault automatically populates fields on the Response Document based on matching fields on the related Health Authority Response record.

feature: eCTD 4.0 Viewing: Stylized Submission Unit XML
