description: The eCTD 4.0 submissionunit.xml now renders in a stylized, human-readable format serving as a navigable table of contents. The Submission Administrative Information section also displays this stylized envelope information, excluding navigable content. Users should use the Re-render Document action to update older renditions to this view.

A simplified Export UI and optimized storage are now available. DAC security is unaffected. Exports now separate submission files from system-generated export summary, manifest, and warning CSV files.
Users can submit UDI data for medical devices to the US FDA's GUDID database.

feature: Link Packaging to MP-Registration Bulk Action
description: This feature updates the Manage Registered Details wizard to include the Link Packaging to Medicinal Product Registrations action. This allows for the automation of the action without the risk of duplicating records.
Users can define a Product Stage and use the values to filter the Create Event Details action. Additionally, the Clinical Study Product is extended to capture the Product Variant.

feature: Multi-Market IDMP Data Model & Aggregation Updates
description: Data model and aggregation logic has been updated to ensure users can efficiently manage IDMP data points that might be reported differently across markets because of differences in controlled vocabularies or other local variations in IDMP implementations.
This feature updates the Registrations data model, creating a more granular source for device identifiers used in IDMP. The IDMP data aggregation algorithm is updated to source data accordingly.

feature: Allow Disabling of Event Change Action Values
description: Admins can inactivate Event Change Action picklist values used in the Create & Manage Event Details wizard.

feature: Support for User Groups in Registration Verification Workflow
description: The Registration Verification workflow supports the "Use Vault user group as participants" configuration option.
UDI Submission generation supports and defaults to EUDAMED's latest XSD version 3.0.30, including a version-number-only change.
Assess Local Activities can now be invoked from an Activity, and can show multiple Events and Activities. Users can save views and share saved views with other users.
Vault deletes unnecessary IDMP output records following the successful generation of the FHIR message.

feature: Wizard Updates for Enhanced Handling of Local Differences
description: Registrations wizards have been updated to enhance handling of local differences, including updating Create Event Details to extend handling for special records as well as updates to Create Registrations & Manage Registered Details validation logic to filter out the relevant details on the Registrations.

feature: Create Related Records: High-Volume Data Support
description: The CASRO process (Create Related Records action, initiated from an Event) is converted into a job to support ten times the payload size.

feature: EUDAMED UDI Submission Generation Restricted to Supported Languages
description: When generating EUDAMED UDI Submissions, text properties are only included for valid supported languages. Any entries for unsupported languages are automatically excluded.

feature: Active Dossier Population for Activities with No Submission
description: This feature enables active dossier population from global content plan dispatch for activities that do not require a submission, and therefore the dispatch does not result in creating or updating submission content plans but does generate active dossier records.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Active Dossier: Improved Uniqueness Key Calculation
description: Vault's auto-generation of the Active Dossier Item Detail Uniqueness Key value is optimized to prevent collisions and data inaccuracy during Active Dossier population.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Extract Proposed Active Dossier Relationships for Registrations: Enablement Update
description: The bulk action to extract the proposed Active Dossier Item Detail Registrations and related relationships from Vault can now be executed without requiring the Active Dossier Registration Tracking application setting to be on. This allows Admins to complete migration before enabling the feature for all users.

Currently, users can drag and drop sections into a GCP with certain limitations. This feature addresses many of those limitations by supporting matching/creation of Event relationships and ability to match/create Document Sets as part of the copy.

feature: GCP Dispatch to Exclude Empty CP Sections
description: Use of Document Set Content Plan relationship at the section level has been deprecated. Users can now populate Document Sets at the Content Plan Item level, then Vault excludes empty Content Plan sections when dispatching to an individual market.

Vault supports bulk export of submissions via the Perform Bulk Actions menu on the All Submissions and Applications tabs. *Auto-on for standard Submission and Application object types (excluding Global). Custom Object Types require configuration.

The "Enable identifying empty sections in the Viewer" application setting now uses a new system-managed object, Application Metadata, to facilitate processing. The Empty Section Indicator is maintained if your Application is in the Active status.

feature: Active Dossier: Support for Tracking Vaccines & Injectables
description: This feature introduces an expansion of Active Dossier & Content Planning to support container-level tracking. A new Container field is added across RIM's Product relationships and Active Dossier to more efficiently manage vaccine and injectable documents.

feature: Active Dossier: Exclude Submission Country from Generation
description: A new field on Submission Country, Exclude from Active Dossier Generation, determines if the Country should be skipped when generating Active Dossier records. The Submission Country value can be defaulted based on the Application Country, and Procedure Type Country Constraints can be used to default values on the relevant Application Countries.

feature: Update Active Dossier from Country Decision Detail
description: Active Dossier Status updates can be triggered from an entry action on the Country Decision Detail lifecycle to allow for more granular updates to Active Dossier Item Details on a per-Country basis.
The existing Export Excel Tree with All Descendants action in Active Dossier Viewer is updated to respect the saved filters set in the Viewer during extraction.

feature: Active Dossier: Country Status Icon Improvements
description: New icons are introduced to the Active Dossier Viewer to represent Pending Current, Pending Superseded, and Pending Deprecation.

feature: Automatically Run Early Notification Rules on Case Promotion
description: In Vaults with early notification rules configured, the rules now automatically execute upon Case promotion.
Users can now manually sync a Foreign Localized Case with its associated global Case to update existing records and fields or generate missing child and grandchild records with the latest data.
Veeva Safety can now generate the version of the FDA MedWatch 3500A form released in September 2025.
Admins can now link a secondary, device-specific agency to a country.

feature: Exclude Reporter Information by Destination on CIOMS I Forms
description: Admins can now configure their Vault to exclude reporter information when sending CIOMS I forms to certain partners.
Users can now generate an Interval Tabulation of SAEs and an Interval Tabulation of SARs with their DSUR.

feature: Allow Marketing to Investigational (Same Agency) Reporting Scenario
description: For products that are on both postmarket studies and clinical trials, Admins can now configure reporting rules for the scenario when a single agency requires submissions to both premarket and postmarket centers for the same event.

feature: Case Validation: Masked and Blinded Data
description: Vault now validates Case data that is masked, blinded, or undergoes any data transformation during Transmission generation.
Admins can now configure customized web-based intake forms to collect structured adverse event report data directly from reporters.
Vault no longer limits Gateway Profile creation during Transmission Profile creation.
Veeva Safety now autocodes Company Products during Case processing.

feature: Configurable Event Reported Verbatim on Import
description: Admins can now configure Transmission Profiles to determine how Vault maps data when the E.i.1.1a and E.i.1.1b data elements are blank on E2B(R3) and JSON imported files.
Rules-based narratives now support generating narratives in Japanese for submission to the PMDA.

Vault now populates the reason for an expectedness evaluation in the new Expectedness Details field on Japan Localized Case Assessments, and populates a Localized Event (LLT), based on the global Event (LLT), on Japan Localized Case Adverse Events.
Admins can now configure time-based automatic submission of partially completed online questionnaires.

feature: Vault No Longer Creates Gateway Profiles
description: When Admins create an AS2 Gateway type Transmission Profile for use with an AS2 Connection, Vault no longer creates a corresponding Gateway Profile.
Veeva Safety now performs Case Validations for Electronic Medical Device Reporting (eMDR) device forms.
Veeva Safety now performs Case Validations for Manufacturer Incident Report (MIR) device forms.

feature: Remove Blind Protection for Investigator Causality
description: For Vaults using the Isolate Blinded Clinical Trial Information feature, investigator causality entered in Case Assessment Results is no longer treated as blind-sensitive. This means that updates to the blinded record now sync to the unblinded record, and vice-versa. Sponsor causality continues to be treated as blind-sensitive.

feature: Aggregate Support of New Study Types
description: Users can now run aggregate reports that automatically include the new Study types of Patient Support Program (4), Market Research Program (5), and Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform (6).

feature: PMDA: Combination Product Registration Variant Matching
description: For Cases with Combination Products, the Retrieve Case Product Registration action now filters registrations based on Product Variants.

feature: Japan Reporting: Cross Reporting Registration Improvements
description: In Vaults configured for Substance matching during cross reporting, when generating Case Product Registrations on cases for Japan, Vault now excludes Combination Product Registrations.

feature: Blind Isolation: Simplified Japan Registration Unblinding
description: The Retrieve Case Product Registrations action now takes into consideration unblinded products and creates a single Japan Registration.

feature: FDA FAERS E2B(R3): Replace Unsupported Characters
description: On FDA FAERS E2B(R3) files, Vault now replaces unsupported characters with valid ones.
Veeva Safety now supports the acknowledgment package provided by the FDA for eMDR (Electronic Medical Device Reporting) submissions.

feature: Ignore Non-Active Studies During Reporting Rules Evaluation
description: When evaluating regulatory obligations during safety reporting, Vault now ignores Study Registrations in the New lifecycle state, in addition to the Inactive and Deprecated lifecycle states.

feature: FDA Reporting: Unique Device Identifiers Update
description: When generating FDA eMDR and FDA MedWatch 3500A (September 2025 version) forms, Vault now concatenates the Unique Identifier and Unique Production Identifier values on the Case Product to populate the D4 field.

feature: FDA FAERS E2B(R3) Primary IND Selection
description: Using the new FDA Primary IND setting on Transmission Studies, Admins can now configure the most relevant Study Registrations for cross reporting to the FDA.

feature: FDA Summary Type Reporting Rules Automation
description: For Cases that specify an FDA Summary Type, Vault now restricts rule evaluation and Early Notifications to the FDA Agency ruleset and suppresses general distribution rules.

feature: FDA Reporting: Support for Individual Study Device Submissions
description: When a study device is specified on a Transmission using the FDA MedWatch 3500A (August 2024 Version) form, Vault now populates only that device in sections D, G, and H of the form.
If a case’s safety parameters change after transmission generation, running the Evaluate Regulatory Obligations action now includes updating the Study Content Protection setting.
When certain patient and reporter identifiers are blank on a Case, Vault now populates nullFavors on FDA E2B(R3) files in the FAERS and VAERS formats.

feature: Safety Rules Troubleshooting Tool for Localized Case
description: The Safety Rules Troubleshooting tool now executes for Localized Cases and PMDA-specific rule evaluations.
Veeva Safety now supports the International Sort Order on SOC terms in the MedDRA dictionary.

feature: Japan Reporting: Improved Validations for Blinded Product Submissions
description: When reporting to the PMDA for blinded Case Products, Vault no longer validates that substance information is included.

feature: Validation Criteria: MFDS Validation Improvements for Device Products
description: Validations for submissions to Korea no longer require drug data points such as MPID or substance.

feature: NMPA Validation Criteria: Exclude External Products
description: Validations for submissions to China no longer require registration approval numbers for external products.

feature: Safety PBRER Case Listing for Summary Tabulation of ADR
description: Vault now generates a list of all cases used in the calculations for the PBRER Summary Tabulation of Adverse Drug Reactions from Postmarketing Sources.

Veeva Safety now supports a fully responsive UI for both desktop and mobile devices. Screens automatically adjust their content and presentation depending on the screen size, while maintaining usability, readability and accessibility.

feature: Validation Criteria: EMA Identifiable Patient Updates
description: When masking patient identifiers on EMA E2B(R3) files, Vault now supports MSK as a masking value.

feature: NMPA Validation Criteria: Localize G.K.2.2 and H.1 Validations
description: The NMPA validations for G.K.2.2 and H.1 now have specified criteria that properly aligns with Chinese business rule requirements.
On submissions to China, Vault no longer requires the Test Date element for Test Results.

feature: View E2B Readable Renditions in Vault
description: E2B Readable Renditions now open in a Vault pop-up document viewer. This feature is Auto-on for users with the Edit Relationships permission. For any other user who needs to use E2B Readable Renditions, Admins must grant this permission.

feature: Validation Criteria: Use EVCTMPROD Destinations for EMA Validations
description: EVCTMPROD is now an acceptable destination for EMA Validations.

feature: Product Browser: Allow Multiple Trade Names
description: The Safety Product Browser now allows for multiple trade names per Registration. Additionally, a new UI improvement is added to wrap all trade names in tag format.
Notifications about unsupported units of measurement on regional E2B files now identify the correct regional transmission document type.
For initial and follow-up Cases, Vault now maps the Inbox Item Significance to either the Significant or Non-Significant field on the Case.
Vault now automatically maps Special Situation and Invalid Reason data from Inbox Items to Cases during initial promotion.

Users can now sort information in the Medical Review Timeline chronologically or reverse-chronologically, view the section in a modeless pop-up window, and see dedicated visual indicators for unknown dates.

feature: Case Compare: MedDRA Preferred Term Matching
description: Admins can now configure Preferred Term-level matching for MedDRA coded case data during Case Follow-up and Case Version Compare.
When a product with an unknown formulation is reported, Vault now performs verification checks against all Product Registrations within the Product Family.
Hierarchical MedDRA terms on active Datasheets, Watchlists, MedDRA Queries, and Product-Event Combinations are now automatically updated during the dictionary upversion process.
Veeva Safety extends support of Combination Products to Study Products on clinical trial Studies. *Auto-on in Vaults with Study Products that include a Combination Product value.
Veeva Safety introduces the Case Combination Product object for Combination Product coding support.

feature: Document Intake Panel: Support for Additional Fields
description: The Document Intake panel now supports more Inbox Item fields.

feature: Readability Updates to Rules Based Narratives Follow-up Summary
description: Rules based narrative follow-up Summary Statements now use more concise phrasing, are limited to Investigator or MAH assessments, and improve clarity when suspect Case Products are added or Cause of Death and Dechallenge information is changed.
Vault now archives Inbox Items that are inactive for 180 days following promotion.
The new Email Address field on the Site object type of the Organization object enables storing FDA device manufacturer information.

feature: Standard FDA eMDR Transmission Profile Document Type
description: The standard Transmission Profile for device submissions to the FDA now includes the FDA eMDR document type.

feature: FDA E2B(R3) Relabeled to FDA FAERS E2B(R3)
description: This feature relabels the FDA E2B(R3) file to FDA FAERS E2B(R3). There are no changes to document export or data mapping.
During JSON import, Vault now excludes unsupported field types including custom objects, system fields, non-Vault fields, and fields on the ignore list.

feature: Activate the Safety Monthly Maintenance Job
description: The Safety Monthly Maintenance Job is now active in all Vaults. In Vaults that already had this job active, there are no behavior changes.
Safety Signal now automates the loading, cleaning, and linking of EVDAS eRMR data with line listing.

feature: Enhanced Logic Operators for Signal Alerts
description: Safety Signal now allows enhanced Signal Alert Rule logic with AND/OR operators.

feature: MedDRA Query Analysis for FAERS & VAERS
description: Safety Signal now supports MedDRA Query calculations on FAERS and VAERS data.
Users can now download a summary of Signal Calculation configuration data.
Signal Reporting Periods can now be created on a weekly schedule.

Signal Detection Plans provide a structured data model with product risk tiers guiding the review frequencies, methodologies, and deadlines across products. Safety Topics track medical concerns and events of special interest directly in Vault. Automated execution is not supported in this release.
Safety Signal and SafetyDocs introduce automated creation of Signal Reporting Periods based on a predefined schedule for a Signal Product Profile.

Users can now generate compliant PMDA periodic safety reports in Workbench for organizations with cases reportable to the PMDA. This includes J-PSR Form 3, J-PSR Form 4, and J-NUPR Line Listing, along with Open Case and Case Series listings.
Users can now generate Pregnancy Annex 3 tabulations and associated Case and Event line listings in Workbench, complying with EMA pregnancy exposure guidelines.
Workbench Dashboards now anchor total rows so they remain visible regardless of scrolling.
Admins can now configure Safety Workbench views to let users filter report and dashboard data by either the latest version or all versions of a case.

feature: Save Report Sets to the Library
description: Users can now upload Workbench Report Sets directly to the Library as a single Document.
Admins can now create Workbench dashboards using views that require SQL parameters.

feature: Advanced Logic for Report Set Filters
description: Users can now specify advanced logic between filters on a report set.
Users can now choose the Narrow option when filtering by SMQ or CMQ.
Workbench now includes a new type of Component that displays static text, enabling Admins to add documentation or welcome pages.
When generating a Workbench Report from a Workbench Dashboard Component, Vault now prompts users to enter a custom name.
Users can now click into a Text cell to open a dialog that displays the entire field.
Users can now paste rows of data from Excel or Google Sheets into Workbench text filters.

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
description: This release includes a number of standardizations across the Safety Suite, such as page layouts, and label updates.
Admins can now configure document deletion actions to capture a deletion reason and enforce a defined retention period.

feature: Specify Reply-to Value for PVA Distribution Emails
description: Custom reply-to values can be defined for emails sent related to PVA Obligation Activities.
Users can now import literature article list files from the International Medical Information Center (IMIC).
Users can now generate a merged draft PDF at any time during the PSMF Binder workflow, with the option to exclude annex documents.
Vault automatically transitions an approved PVA from a pending state to its effective steady state once the effective date is reached.
Users can now track, assign, and resolve PSMF-related requests from Health Authorities and partners.
This feature supports scheduled PVA periodic reviews and task generation, with automated up-versioning based on review outcomes.
Admins can now disable the automatic creation of Logbook Entries when PSMF documents are updated.

feature: Signal Individual Case Review for SafetyDocs
description: Safety and SafetyDocs users can now perform Individual Case Reviews.

feature: Specify Start Date for Multi-Agreement Activities
description: Event start dates can be set for PVA Multi-Agreement Activities to more accurately calculate Activity due dates.

feature: Prevent Lifecycle State Change When Error Occurs While Generating PSMF PDFs
description: Vault automatically reverts the lifecycle state change when Generate PSMF PDF errors occur.

feature: User License Warnings for SafetyDocs Documents
description: Users with invalid licenses receive a warning notification upon accessing  SafetyDocs document types.

feature: Automatic Inbox Item Creation for Adverse Event Report Documents
description: Safety Vaults using Vault AI can now automatically create Inbox Items following upload of a Case > Source > Adverse Event Report document type to the Library.
The Narrative Agent now includes standard prompt updates and the ability to configure custom actions and supplemental instructions.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Enhanced Change Control for Materials
description: This feature enhances the existing Quality-RIM Connection by enabling change controls to be applied against the Material records, in addition to Products. Materials include Packaging, Actives Substances & Inactive Ingredients. This level of detail facilities Batch Release.

The Clinical Operations-Vault CRM Connection enables HCP related Activities and Interactions to be transferred between Clinical Operations and Vault CRM. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Improved Error Handling for Protocol Deviations
description: Vault generates detailed User Exception Items (UEI) specifically for individual Protocol Deviation records containing unmapped Category or Subcategory values.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Restricted Subject Visit Creation
description: This feature simplifies the creation logic for Unblinded Subject Visit Data via the Clinical Operations-EDC Connection. If Restricted data is present for the Event in EDC, an Unblinded Subject Visit Data record is created. This feature maps to the "Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Restricted Subject Visit Data Synchronization" (26R2-07X001) feature in the CDMS RIA.

The Clinical Operations-EDC Connection includes summary Additive SDV information for relevant Subject Visits in the data transfer from EDC (CDMS) Vaults to CTMS Vaults. This feature maps to the "Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Additive SDV transferred to CTMS" (26R2-0EW030) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Query Metric for Site Connect Study Plan
description: The Clinical Operations-EDC Connection supports populating the Average Number of Days to Resolve Queries field for each site for the Site Connect Study Plan.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Limit Updates to Sites for Connected Studies
description: For studies that are connected to CTMS, sites cannot be created or deleted through Veeva EDC, and their connected fields cannot be edited. This feature maps to the "Site Management Updates for Clinical Operations - EDC Connected Studies" (26R2-088004) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Support Repeating Item Groups on Procedures
description: Procedure configuration in EDC Studio has been rebranded from "Integration Configuration" to "Payable Activity Configuration". A new UI introduces flexible configuration options allowing Procedures to contain data from repeating item groups and configuration options to define repeating item groups as one or multiple CTMS Procedure records. This feature maps to the "Support Repeating Item Groups on Procedures" (26R2-085006) in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Apply Cause of Death Details Only to Death-Related SAEs
description: This connection is enhanced to support an optional configuration in EDC that applies Death information only to cases that are distinctly death Cases (for example, when the Seriousness is Death, or the Outcome is Fatal). This feature maps to the "Safety Integrations: In Case of Death Information Only for Fatal Events" (26R2-0OT017) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Transmission Profile per Connection
description: Admins can now configure a distinct Transmission Profile for each EDC Vault using the Safety-EDC Connection.

The Safety-EDC Connection updates data exchange, including linking Cases marked for follow-up to new Inbox Items, retaining the system link (link__sys) across follow-ups, and displaying translated error messages for EDC-specific failures.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Retain Primary Designation for Multi-Event Cases
description: Changes to primary AE are now strictly a human response and are no longer updated automatically by the Safety-EDC Connection.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Respond to Form Sequence Number
description: Form sequence number is now included in Case Adverse Events as a new field to indicate which EDC AE form creates the Safety AE. This is primarily to distinguish the same Event Reported, but different instances, such as if the patient has two migraine cases.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Combine Reporter & Sender Comments for Multi-Event Follow-Up Cases
description: To ensure multi-event cases are properly supported, the Safety-EDC connection now concatenates Reporter Comments on receipt of subsequent Follow-ups. Comments are not concatenated on Merge or Create follow-up actions, only on subsequent multi-event follow-ups.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Prioritize Actions Taken for Multi-Event Cases
description: When promoting Cases with multiple Adverse Events for the same Product, Vault now prioritizes the most severe Action Taken values (for example, Drug Withdrawn).

This feature automatically pulls CLM statistics from CRM-connected Vaults into the Medical Vault via a standard Vault to Vault connection. Users can now view these statistics for medical content. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.
This feature allows the transfer of approved documents to Vault CRM. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

This feature transfers steady state Email Templates and Fragments from Medical Vaults to Vault CRM. Document relationships are retained during the transfer. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: Populate Inquiry’s Preferred Contact Information on Case
description: This feature populates the new Preferred Contact Information field on the Case record in MedInquiry with the Person Information record created from the contact information specified on the Vault CRM Medical Inquiry. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

This feature automatically pulls CLM statistics from CRM-connected Vaults into the PromoMats Vault via a standard Vault to Vault connection. Users can now view these statistics for commercial content. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.
This feature allows the transfer of approved documents to Vault CRM. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

This feature transfers steady state Email Templates and Fragments from PromoMats Vaults to Vault CRM. Document relationships are retained during the transfer. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Enhanced Change Control Integration Deleted RCI Enhancement
description: The Enhanced Change Control integration between Veeva Quality and Veeva RIM is now enhanced to ensure the system does not attempt to recreate Regulatory Change Items that were previously deleted from a Quality Vault.

This feature enhances the existing Quality-Safety connection to share the status of the respective record transferred via the integration, such as the ability to indicate if an Inbox Item has been promoted to a Case, or if a complaint intake created via a Safety Case has been promoted to a Complaint.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Document Creation Triggers Outbound Job
description: The Quality-RIM connection now triggers the Document Integration when any document or document version is created directly in its steady state, creating the CrossLink in the target Vault.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive, Safety
description: Data model alignments across Veeva Safety and Veeva RIM support greater data transfer, including multi-trade names and product variant substance information.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: RIM Connection Stats
description: RIM Admins and users have visibility into the daily number of automated transactions completed by the RIM-Clinical Operations Connection via the new Connection Stats object.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Submission Tracking Enhancements
description: The connection supports tracking for withdrawn and implicitly approved applications, as well as enhanced support for resubmissions.

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
feature: Safety-RIM Connection: New IDMP MPID Field Mapping
description: The Safety-RIM connection now sends the RIM IDMP MPID value to the dedicated Safety IDMP MPID field.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Geographic Assignment Rollout
description: Vault creates a unique Training Requirement for every version of a connected Clinical Operations document, allowing Training Admins to manage each version independently and release them for individual regions or countries as appropriate. This feature is Auto-on with required configuration.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Support for Cross-Domain Users
description: The Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection can transfer Cross-Domain users across these Vaults.

feature: 30-Day Offline Experience in the Mobile App
description: This feature enables MyVeeva users to continue interacting with the MyVeeva for Patients Mobile app for up to 30 days without internet or network access before prompting the patient to access a connection. While offline, the app will save any data the user submits and will submit it once the device
This feature enables a MyVeeva User to update their own username, password, email address, phone number, and PIN from the Account Settings page in the iOS, Android, and web apps.

This feature enables site staff to generate an activation code from Study Connect or from Veeva ePRO that MyVeeva users can use for registration. The app ensures that it collects signatures that are hand-drawn when a user is not able to perform phone-
This feature enables all users to set up PIN login on the iOS and Android MyVeeva apps. Previously, only users without an email address or phone number were able to set up a PIN.
This feature enables MyVeeva users to initiate the process of deleting their account.

This feature enables sponsor and site staff to optimize study text to be viewed in languages that are structured in a right-to-left format, such as Hebrew and Arabic. It also enables MyVeeva users to view the app and any translated content in a right-to-left language.

This feature enables MyVeeva users to view application text, emails, notifications, text messages, and the terms of use and privacy policy in Arabic (Israel), Catalan (Spain), English (Australia), German (Belgium), Hebrew (Israel), and Hungarian (Hungary).

This enhancement allows users to bulk process the following Study Team Assignment activities:  - Activate assignments  - Populate the Start and End Date-Time fields  - Initiate the Delegation Acceptance workflow

feature: User Administration: Staff & Monitor Create Enhancements
description: These enhancements focus on the create flows for Staff and Monitor/External users: - Required duplicate entry of email address upon user creation - Updated user experience for managing a Staff's site-specific access and permissions - Ability to create Staff without user accounts

This feature adds the following language locales to the list of available languages for document and patient records in SiteVault:  - Arabic (Israel) - Catalan (Spain) - English (Australia) - German (Belgium) - Hebrew (Israel) - Hungarian (Hungary)

This feature introduces the Free Tools menu with links to ClinicalTrials.Veeva (CTV) and Veeva Launch Pad. CTV is a free clinical study search and Veeva Launch Pad is a free password management tool designed to help you more easily access sponsor systems.

This feature introduces public APIs for user administration functionality, including creating new Staff and Monitors/External Users and editing their system permissions. These APIs are available to SiteVault Enterprise customers.
This feature introduces a Notes field to the Study Assignment record. The Notes field is a space to share additional details regarding the user or assignment information.

feature: eConsent: New Fields for Verifying Consent
description: This enhancement adds the following fields to the eConsent Form Responses table:   - Document Descrtipion  - Signature Date

feature: eConsent: New Site Signature Record Fields
description: This feature allows site users to view the signature records for the site signatories that signed a participant's ICF.
This feature allows users to select and approve multiple documents simultaneously from the Study eBinder.

feature: Documents: New Doc Types, Updated Doc Details
description: This feature includes the following changes to SiteVault Documents: - New document types: Recruitment Plan, System User Access, Participant Decoding Event, IP Relabeling - Updated document descriptions: Conflict of Interest, Feasibility Questionnaire
When a user navigates away from the Site eBinder, this feature ensures the site selected at that time remains selected upon return.

feature: Study eBinder: Document List Sorted by Version
description: In the Study eBinder, when a user epxands a document view to reveal multiple versions, the documents are sorted by version.
For Sites, the look and feel of eBinder has changed to better support the process for uploading and approving documents. Subtabs now group documents by their state of approval.

feature: Device Registration Code Relabeled to Activation Code
description: With this change, the code to provide participants who wish to register for MyVeeva for Patients without providing an email address or phone number is the Activation Code. Previously, this was labeled as the Device Registration Code (DRC).
With this update, Site Users can more easily see and select all unread safety distribution documents within Study Connect.

feature: Merge Fields in the Header and Footer
description: This feature enables Vault Merge Fields for use in the eConsent Header and Footer components.
This feature enables sponsor staff to see when a consent form was signed and a more recognizable document description in the signature records.
This feature enables the eConsent editor to highlight the blocks and content that have errors to help users identify and fix issues more quickly.

feature: Create and Assign Site Users in the ePRO Vault
description: This feature enables sponsor staff to add a site staff member to a study in ePRO Vault. The site staff will receive an email that notifies them of the new study access or prompts them to finish registering their account.

This feature enables users to create study data and manage sponsor and site personnel access to Veeva ePRO and MyVeeva Studio in a new ePRO Vault. Users can also release languages and access standard reports in the ePRO Vault.

feature: Studio and Study Home Redirection After Session Timeout
description: This feature redirects sponsor staff to the page they were previously viewing when they log back in after being automatically logged out due to timing out.
This feature enables internal study staff (sponsors or CROs) to have study oversight, to monitor compliance metrics across sites and patients, and to download reports.
This feature enables site staff to connect their ePRO vault to SiteVault as part of the new Veeva ePRO.
This feature enables site staff to administer participant and event activities, including survey interactions, as part of the new Veeva ePRO.

feature: Veeva ePRO: Site Study Details, Notifications, and Reports
description: This feature enables site staff to manage collection versions and run reports as part of the new Veeva ePRO.

feature: Clinical Operations to ePRO Vault Connection
description: This feature allows a Clinical Operations Vault and an ePRO Vault to be connected and for Study, Study Country, and Study Site records to be automatically created in ePRO from the Clinical Operations Vault.
This feature enables internal study staff (sponsors or CROs) to complete the UAT process for ePRO and eClinRO collections as part of the new Veeva ePRO .
This feature enables site staff to receive email notifications as part of the new Veeva ePRO.
This feature enables Veeva ePRO to be viewed in Japanese for site users in a Japan Study Site.

feature: Expanded Access to Configure FTP Exports
description: This feature enables sponsor staff with access to MyVeeva Studio from an ePRO Vault to configure FTP exports.

feature: Include a Survey's Instance Number and Additional Schedule Detail in Reports
description: This feature enables sponsor staff to see a survey's recurring instance number as well as the triggering schedule's export detail in survey response and compliance reports so they can use it as an input for data analysis.

feature: Remove SiteVault Terminology Where Not Applicable
description: This feature removes references to SiteVault to ensure that text accurately represents the applications that may be in use.

feature: Single Select Optional Answer Shown as a Radio Button
description: This feature updates optional answers in surveys to display as radio buttons instead of check boxes.
This feature separates the translation files by survey or group to make it easier for translation vendors to manage the translation process.
With this feature, relevant user actions from 24R2 features are added as audit events on the MyVeeva audit trail.

This feature enables sponsors to configure study countries so that sites in those countries cannot collect personally identifiable information (PII) from participants, while still allowing those participants to use MyVeeva for Patients to complete surveys.

feature: Explicit Privacy Notice and Terms of Service Consent
description: This feature explicitly asks users to accept the Privacy Notice and Terms of Service when they register for MyVeeva. It also alerts users when Veeva has made updates to the policies since the last time a user logged in.
This feature enables a participant using the iOS or Android app to reset their password without needing to access the Web app.
This feature allows a MyVeeva user to complete as many As-Needed surveys as they need to while offline.

feature: Link to Account Deletion Information Added
description: This feature adds a link to the account deletion information on the Account page.

feature: Sponsors Can Add Informational Links for Study Participants
description: This feature enables sponsors to add a website link to a resource that they want study participants to be able to see in Studio. The resource link is then displayed in the MyVeeva for Patients app.
This feature automatically updates the user's time zone to match the time zone of their device or browser.

Hotfixed languages are pulled into this release so that MyVeeva users can view application text, emails, notifications, text messages, and the terms of use and privacy policy in Bulgarian (Bulgaria), Danish (Denmark), and Greek (Greece).

feature: App Version Added to Account Settings
description: This feature adds the version number to the Account page under Settings.
This feature enables localization for country names when a MyVeeva user is adding or editing their phone number.
This feature improves the readability of error messages for right-to-left language users when a user enters an incorrect number in a number-based field.
This feature enables the app to automatically switch to the study that the user selects a notification for.

feature: Monitor/External User Creation - Override Option Removed
description: This feature removes the Override Option that was sometimes displayed when creating a new Monitor/External User. This feature enhances the Study detail page, shifting to a horizontal tab presentation to simplify navigation. The View Details button opens a drawer with study information, available to edit for those with the required permissions.
This feature updates the Connected Study Type Picklist options with current information.

feature: eConsent: eConsent Activity on Participant Details
description: With this feature, site users can easily view and update a participant's eConsent activity directly from the Participant detail page. Available tabs include Consent Forms, Signatories, Form Responses, Additional Responses, and Documents.

feature: eConsent: Two Witnesses on eConsent Forms
description: With this feature, users can associate multiple witnesses with a participant and select up to two witnesses to send eConsent forms for signature.

feature: eConsent: eConsent actions in Study eBinder
description: This feature adds eConsent actions to the Document Actions menu in the Study eBinder.
This feature provides Administrators with the ability to enable or disable eConsent on a study. The field is located in the details drawer, on the Study details page.

As part of this change, all eConsent forms are sent to the connected Clinical Vault on approval, whether they are sponsor-

feature: eConsent: eConsent Activity on Study Details
description: This feature introduces the Consent Forms tab to Study Details. Site users can view the study-specific consent forms, their status, version, and more. From this page, users can also initiate eConsent form actions by using the associated actions menu.
This feature improves the action of logging an issue from the Document Viewer and provides a new option to log an issue from the Study eBinder.

This feature introduces the Request Missing Document button, available in the monitor's view of the Study eBinder. This button allow monitors to initiate a task for the site staff to provide a document that is missing from the monitor's view of the eBinder.

feature: Monitoring: Monitoring Profile Docs and Updated UI/UX
description: In addition to study-specific documents, Monitors can now review profile documents as well (CVs, training, etc.). This feature also changes the way monitors review documents, both from the Document Viewer and from the Study eBinder.

For Monitors, the look and feel of eBinder has changed to better support the monitoring process in SiteVault. There is a new column for Monitoring and documents are now grouped into Sub-tabs based on their monitoring status for the selected study.

feature: Updated Connected Study Email Notification Redirect
description: This feature updates the link in the notification email to let site staff members know that a form is ready for a countersignature and directs them to a better location to access the countersignature functionality.

feature: eConsent Form Image Support in Header and Footer
description: This feature enables the person who is creating or modifying an eConsent form to add images, such as logos, to the header and footer applied to .DOCX and .PDF file formats.
This feature updates the user interface for entering multi-factor authentication codes when a user is signing an eConsent using the tap-to-sign method.

feature: New ePRO Report: Connected SiteVault Study Audit Trail
description: This feature enables site users to run a Connected SiteVault Study Audit Trail report in Veeva ePRO. It includes site, caregiver, and participant actions pertaining to MyVeeva that were performed for the connected SiteVault study.

This feature enables sponsors to create rules for check events, which calculate and display values based on survey data when a site user runs a check event.

feature: MyVeeva Calendar Alias Added to ePRO
description: This feature enables site users to copy an email alias that allows them to send calendar invitations from their preferred calendar application. The visit information will be displayed in the MyVeeva for Patients app.

description: This feature enables users who are completing a data change to answer a date, time, or datetime question with any value, ignoring the configured range of minimum and maximum values.

feature: Prevent Event Removal when Used in Approved Collection
description: This feature prevents users from deleting events that have been used in approved collections.

This feature supports the new rules functionality and ensures that sponsor/CRO staff members can reference data from ePRO for use in rule templates.

feature: Study Sites and Study Countries Creation Limited when Connected to Clinical Operations
description: This feature ensures that when a study comes from Clinical Operations, users can't create countries or sites associated with the study, ensuring that all information is sent from and managed in the Clinical Operations Vault.

feature: Improved Timeliness for ePRO Compliance Data
description: This feature improves the timeliness of ePRO compliance counts that are displayed to site staff to ensure they have the latest data about surveys that are due soon or missed.
